Formula: Base expectation.
Equation (API stats only): (Σ_{g ∈ GLb} ω_g·npts_g + k·π) / (Σ_g ω_g + k), ω_g = 0.5^(y − y_g) · 0.5^(n_g/8) · (0.5 if y_g < y and team_g ≠ p's team in week w, else 1). Veteran: k = 2, π = π_pos(y). Rookie (rookie_season = y): fd = max(0, 1 − (w − 1)/4), k = 3·fd + 2(1 − fd), π = (3·fd·π_r + 2(1 − fd)·π_pos(y)) / k, π_r = SP_y(ov,pos) if drafted in that season's LOTG rookie draft, else π_R(y,pos,b).

Formula: Expected points.
Equation (API stats only): max(E_base(p), a_pos·E_base(q) + b_pos·E_base(p)) if p = NMU and q = the absent teammate with the highest E_base, where q sat out (no game-log row in w; a live week: injS(q) ∈ {Out, IR, PUP, Sus, NA, DNR}), is on wr(·,y,w) for that team, played for it earlier this season (last season counts when w ≤ 4), and E_base(q) > E_base(p); else E_base(p). (a_pos, b_pos) = least squares without intercept of the backup's actual npts on (E_base(q), E_base(p)) over every NFL next-man-up event 2019-2025 (≥ 30 per position).

Formula: FAAB the winning manager spent to land this waiver claim. = the winning claim's waiver_bid; 0 for free-agent / commissioner adds.
Notes: Populated only on waiver rows.
Equation (API stats only): bid(x) if type(x) = waiver; 0 if type(x) ∈ {free_agent, commissioner}

Formula: Total FAAB standing on this player this week. Sum of one bid per team — its winning claim, or its final claim if it lost.
Notes: The winning bid sits on top of this stack. One bid per team: a manager's own superseded resubmissions are not extra bids, and a claim that could never have been honoured (roster over the limit, short on FAAB, a player it would drop had already played) was never in the auction.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{u ∈ Bd} bid(c_u), Bd = {teams u with a valid waiver claim on a in x's waiver run}, c_u = u's winning claim, else u's last-created claim on a (claims = transactions with type = waiver, status ∈ {complete, failed}, adds[a] = u; invalid = failed for roster limit / insufficient FAAB / locked drop)  — where Bd = rosters u with a counted claim on a in x's waiver run (type = waiver on a, status complete or failed, not failed for roster limit / insufficient FAAB / an already-played drop); c_u = u's winning claim, else u's last-created claim on a

Formula: How much the winning bid beat the next-highest valid bid. winning_bid − max(other valid bids ≤ winning_bid); the whole winning bid when nobody else bid.
Notes: Bids above the winning bid were invalid (roster full / short on FAAB) and are ignored. An uncontested claim beat a $0 runner-up, so its margin is the bid itself — not blank.
Equation (API stats only): bid(x) − max({bid(c_u) : u ∈ Bd∖{t}, bid(c_u) ≤ bid(x)} ∪ {0})  — where Bd = rosters u with a counted claim on a in x's waiver run (type = waiver on a, status complete or failed, not failed for roster limit / insufficient FAAB / an already-played drop); c_u = u's winning claim, else u's last-created claim on a

Formula: The winner's markup over the runner-up, as a share of the winning bid (so it's comparable across big and small bids). (winning_bid − runner_up) / winning_bid × 100.
Notes: 0–100; 100 against a $0 runner-up, an uncontested claim included. Blank only when the winning bid is $0.
Equation (API stats only): 100 · (bid(x) − max({bid(c_u) : u ∈ Bd∖{t}, bid(c_u) ≤ bid(x)} ∪ {0})) / bid(x); blank if bid(x) = 0  — where Bd = rosters u with a counted claim on a in x's waiver run (type = waiver on a, status complete or failed, not failed for roster limit / insufficient FAAB / an already-played drop); c_u = u's winning claim, else u's last-created claim on a

Formula: How many managers had a bid standing on this player this week. One per team — its winning claim, or its final claim if it lost.
Notes: Measures interest, not wins. A manager's own superseded resubmissions count once between them, and a claim that could never have been honoured (roster over the limit, short on FAAB, a player it would drop had already played) does not count.
Equation (API stats only): |Bd|  — where Bd = rosters u with a counted claim on a in x's waiver run (type = waiver on a, status complete or failed, not failed for roster limit / insufficient FAAB / an already-played drop)

Formula: Fantasy points per game the added player produced while on this team: the league's own points (player_week) over the games he played while rostered here, from the pickup to the next drop/trade (open-ended if still rostered). A bye or a missed (injury/suspension) week is not a game.
Notes: Started or benched, every game counts. The same number as player_additions' 'Avg PPG on team'. Blank if never rostered for a week; 0 if rostered but never played.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(a, t, T) = Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H(a,w)} pts(a,w) / |{w ∈ Wk : H(a,w)}|; blank if Wk = ∅, 0 if no H week

Stat: Average PPG of dropped player over same time
Formula: The dropped player's points per game over that same window — what you'd have gotten by keeping him. Mean nflverse points from pickup to the added player's next drop/trade.
Notes: Blank with no dropped player or no games in the window.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_nfl(r, [d0, e_a)) = mean{ npts(r,y,w) : APP(r,y,w), gd(r,y,w) ∈ [d0, e_a) }; blank if r = ∅ or no game

Formula: The added player's recent form just before you got him. Mean points over his 5 most-recent PLAYED NFL games before the pickup, from the nflverse game log (re-scored with the league's scoring for that season), on any team or none (fewer than 5 → averages what exists). 'Before' means played on an earlier day than the pickup, in league (Eastern) time: a Saturday pickup does not count that Sunday's game.
Equation (API stats only): avgN(a, d0, 5) = mean of npts over a's last min(5, n) games in GL(a) with gd < d0 (ET day)

Formula: How much more the added player scored than the dropped one over the added player's tenure. Average PPG on team − Average PPG of dropped player over same time.
Notes: A missing side counts as 0; blank when both sides are blank.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(a,t,T) − ppg_nfl(r, [d0, e_a))  (a missing side = 0; blank if both missing)

Stat: Difference of averages adjusted by position
Formula: Same added-minus-dropped PPG gap, but each side scaled for its position so a 12-PPG TE isn't judged like a 12-PPG QB. Each PPG × (league starter avg / position avg).
Notes: Position averages are that season's starter averages from player_week (per-season baselines, so one scoring era never shifts another's; the season in progress uses the previous season's until it has 5 weeks played, then switches retroactively). Blank when both sides are blank.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(a,t,T) · F(y0, pos(a)) − ppg_nfl(r, [d0, e_a)) · F(y0, pos(r))  (missing side = 0)

Formula: Age gap between the added and dropped players. added age − dropped age in decimal years, at the pickup date.
Notes: Negative = the team got younger.
Equation (API stats only): age(a, d0) − age(r, d0),  age(p,d) = (d − birth(p)) / 365.25

Formula: Was this pickup a handcuff? TRUE when, at the moment of the move, the adding team already rosters another player on the SAME NFL team and position (the reference) who either averages 10+ PPG more than the added player, or averages 13+ PPG as a TE (other positions: the position-adjusted equivalent, reference PPG x position factor >= 13 x the TE factor), or was a top-12 pick in that season's rookie draft. Both averages are the reference's last 8 PLAYED NFL games (nflverse, league scoring) before the move; the added player's own average is his last 8 (or fewer). 8 is a hard cutoff: a reference with fewer than 8 games counts only through the draft test.
Notes: The draft test uses the rookie draft of the move's season only once it has happened; before it, there is no draft test. 2020 had no rookie draft, so its test is the first 12 NFL rookies taken in the startup; 2021 uses the rookie draft, not the vet draft. One definition on add_drops, trades (inside Trade addition value), the pick sheets and player_additions. player_week's '- Activated Cuff?' and the team/league 'Number of cuffs rostered|started' apply the same test week by week. Adds the handcuff bonus to Player addition value.
Equation (API stats only): CUFF(a, t, d0)

Formula: How many weeks the added player sat on the bench before his first start for this team. Count of rostered non-starter weeks between the pickup and that first start.
Notes: Blank if he was dropped/traded before ever starting.
Equation (API stats only): |{w ∈ Wk : w < w*}|, w* = min{w ∈ Wk : st(a,t,w) = 1}; blank if no such w*  — where w* = min St (or the first started tenure week)

Stat: Number of starts before next drop
Formula: How many weeks the added player started for this team before leaving it. Count of started weeks between the pickup and the next drop/trade.
Notes: If never dropped, counts starts through the end of the data. On player_additions the pickup is any acquisition (draft, trade or add/drop) and this is the tenure's starts; it replaced the identical 'Starts on team' there.
Equation (API stats only): nst = Σ_{w ∈ Wk(p,t,T)} st(p,t,w)  (p = added / acquired player)  — where nst = Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st(p,t,w)

Formula: How long the added player stayed on this team, in days. Pickup Date to the next drop/trade off this team, or to today if still rostered.
Notes: Blank on a pure drop (no added player); a same-day add-and-move stays 0.
Equation (API stats only): e_a − d0 (days), e_a = min{d(x') > d0 : drops(x')[a] = t or a sent by t in a trade}, else today

Formula: Share of his rostered weeks the added player actually started. Number of starts before next drop / weeks rostered over the tenure.
Notes: Bye and injury weeks stay in the denominator (gross start rate).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st(a,t,w) / |Wk|

Stat: Injury adjusted % of starts made while rostered
Formula: Start rate counting only weeks he was available. Like '% of starts made while rostered' but drops bye/injury weeks from both top and bottom.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H(a,w)} st(a,t,w) / |{w ∈ Wk : H(a,w)}|

Formula: Overall grade of the pickup: how much it out-scored the drop, amplified by how often the player actually started, plus a handcuff bonus. (Difference of averages adjusted by position) × (1 + % of starts) × (1 + injury-adjusted % of starts) + 5 if Cuff at time of pickup?.
Notes: 0 if the added player was never rostered a full NFL week; blank on a pure drop.

Formula: How much this single move nudged the team's tank score: positive = younger and/or richer in future picks (tanking), negative = win-now. Age change rewards swapping in younger players/picks (vs the team's roster age at the time); pick change round-weights future picks received minus sent (1st .25, 2nd .09, 3rd .03, 4th .01; the next 5 seasons; the 2.09 counts as a 2nd, a 5.0X as a 4th).

For a DRAFT pick the draft capital resets at the draft (the future picks come in, the pick is spent), so its Tanking is the AGE term alone — adding the young rookie. Formula: Games the move swung, from the move to today. Every week (regular season, playoffs, 3rd place and toilet games alike, each on its own; the 2026+ two-week final is one game) the team's game against its real opponent is replayed as if the move had never happened: +1 for each loss the move turned into a win, −1 for each win it turned into a loss, ½ for a tie either way. The counterfactual roster: everything GIVEN UP is back from the move to today (a given-up pick = the player drafted with it, from his rookie season) — until the league lets him go (on no roster for 4 straight weeks) or the team re-acquires him. Everything RECEIVED is removed while the team holds it, and follows the team's own later trades: what a received asset is traded for is removed at the share of the team's side it made up (KTC on that trade's day, FAAB weighted 0), averaged over 'removed' and 'kept' — so a scrub turned into a 4th that is 3% of a superstar deal earns 3% of the superstar's swings. A received pick = the player the team drafted with it. Dropping a lineage player ends it. The opponent's lineup changes only if its roster does (a given-up player it held is gone; the team that sent a received player gets him back while we hold him).
Notes: Lineup rule: each week the counterfactual lineup is drawn only from that week's real roster minus what the move brought in, plus what it gave up (a given-up pick = the player drafted with it); no start/sit decision is remade beyond what the change forces. Every slot a removed starter leaves is filled, each by a different player, whenever anyone eligible exists. A given-up player takes one explicit role — fill a cleared slot, take a slot the manager really left empty, or displace one named starter — given-up and bench players compete on points for cleared slots; players may slide between slots to make room. A bench player only fills a cleared slot (directly, or by one starter sliding into it); he never displaces a starter. A player who was not started by ANY team that week counts for at most 1.5 × his average over his previous 3 NFL games, so a bench boom nobody started cannot swing a game. Every substitution must be one the manager could reasonably have made: the incoming player's 3-game average at least the outgoing player's minus 5 (a forced fill is judged against the h-th best-averaging player who could fill one of the h cleared slots; if nobody plausible can play a cleared slot, the best eligible player fills it anyway). A player with fewer than 3 prior NFL games (a rookie's first three) is moved into a counterfactual lineup only if he really started somewhere that week, and can always be moved out of one. Filling every cleared slot comes before points, and a real starter still on the roster never sits while a real bench player starts. Real results use PF with the semifinal +5. FAAB is ignored: selling a player for FAAB alone is a pure drop, buying one a pure add. Off-roster players score their nflverse line under that season's league rules. 2020 uses the ESPN backfill. Grows on old rows as new weeks are played. lotg_support.wins_added.

Start: every asset received, s = 1, j = 0. Walk t's later moves m' in time order: a received pick drafted by t becomes pl(pick) at dd (same s, j); every live item that m' sends ends at d(m'); a drop ends the lineage; a trade's received assets join as group j+1 with s' = clamp(Σ_{items i sent} s_i·K(i, d(m')) / Σ_{assets t sent in m'} K(·, d(m')), 0, 1) (FAAB valued 0; no K on the side → Σ s_i / |sent|). Present in week w: on R(t,w), acquired ≤ w's last game day, ended after w's start; a3(p,w) = mean npts(p) over p's last 3 NFL games before week w (undefined with < 3); val(p,w) = pts(p,w) (any roster, else npts(p,y,w), else 0) if p ∈ ∪_u S(u,w), else min(that, 1.5·a3(p,w)); proven(p,w) = a3(p,w) defined or p ∈ ∪_u S(u,w); LEGAL(L, y) = A matching of the players of L into slots(y) exists, each into a slot whose positions meet elig_y(p); LCF(t,w; OUT, IN) = Kp = S(t,w) ∖ OUT (kept starters), C = slots of starters in OUT (cleared), E_r = slots really empty; arrivals Arr = proven players of IN not on R(t,w) (or on it via OUT); bench Bn = proven players of R(t,w) ∖ S(t,w) ∖ OUT ∖ Arr. Fill bar f = the |C|-th highest a3 among Arr ∪ Bn able to take a cleared slot; plausible(q) = a3(q) ≥ f − 5. Candidates L = (Kp ∖ Dp) ∪ Ar ∪ Fl: Ar ⊆ Arr; Dp ⊆ Kp matched one-to-one to displacers in Ar with val(u) > val(k) and a3(u) ≥ a3(k) − 5; |Ar| − |Dp| ≤ |C| + |E_r|; Fl ⊆ Bn of size ≤ max(0, |C| − (|Ar| − |Dp|)) taken greedily (plausible first, then val) while LEGAL; L must be LEGAL and, if it holds any real bench player, all of Kp. LCF = Σ_{q ∈ L*} val(q,w), L* maximising (|L|, −#implausible entrants, Σ val) lexicographically; WA(move) = Σ_{g ∈ G} Σ_{b ∈ {0,1}^J} Π_j s_j^{b_j}(1 − s_j)^{1 − b_j} · [RES(PF_t(g), PF_o(g)) − RES(PF^cf_t(g,b), PF^cf_o(g))]. J = LIN groups with 0 < s_j < 1 that had a starter in g (largest 6; others with s ≥ ½ and all s = 1 groups counted removed). PF^cf_t(g,b) = Σ_{w ∈ g} [LCF(t,w; OUT_w(b), IN_w) + PF(t,w) − Σ_{q ∈ S(t,w)} pts(q,w)], OUT_w(b) = present LIN players of removed groups, IN_w = GU players active in w. PF^cf_o(g) = Σ_{w ∈ g} [LCF(o,w; GU players on R(o,w), group-0 received players o sent and no longer holds) + PF(o,w) − Σ_{S(o,w)} pts], or PF(o,w) when both sets are empty. A game where no lineup can change returns 0

Formula: A single 0–100 grade for the move (~50 average, 80+ strong): average of FOUR key stats, each turned into its percentile across that sheet's rows. The four — add_drops: Avg net points adjusted by position, Player addition value, latest KTC, % of starts made while rostered; trades: Avg net points adjusted by position, Trade addition value, latest KTC, Trade impact score; the two pick sheets: Avg points added adjusted by position, pick-adjusted Player addition value, latest pick-adjusted KTC, pick-adjusted Avg career PPG adjusted by position. 'Latest KTC' = the most recent populated KTC checkpoint on the row. A value of exactly 0 (no production) ranks at the bottom of its tie so zeros cluster low.
Notes: Pure drops get a separate 0–50 score (half-scaled so a perfect drop never out-scores a good add). Blank for unmade picks, one-sided untracked trades, and untracked players. Percentiles are within each sheet — and the two pick sheets are two SEPARATE universes: non_rookie_picks (the 2020 startup + 2021 vet draft) is ranked only against itself, rookie_picks only against rookie picks, because a 19-round startup snake and a 4-round rookie draft are not comparable. A rookie class is left blank until week 8 of its rookie season (too little football to grade) and is held out of the pick-adjustment reference pools until then. non_rookie_picks scores are then de-trended for draft slot — see 'O-Score draft-slot de-trend'.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{j=1..4} pctl(v_j ; v_j over the sheet's rows), a v_j of exactly 0 ranked lowest in its tie; add_drops v = ⟨Avg net points adjusted by position⟩, ⟨Player addition value⟩, latest K checkpoint, ⟨% of starts made while rostered⟩; trades v = ⟨Avg net points adjusted by position⟩, ⟨Trade addition value⟩, latest K checkpoint, ⟨Trade impact score⟩; pick sheets v = ⟨Avg points added adjusted by position⟩, ⟨Pick-adjusted Difference in Player addition value⟩, latest pick-adjusted K, ⟨Pick-adjusted Difference in Avg career PPG adjusted by position⟩ (each pick sheet ranked separately); pure drop: ½ · the same mean

Formula: Applied to the non_rookie_picks O-Score after it is computed, so an early bust and a late-round bust with the same on-field return are not graded alike. Expected O-Score is fitted as a smooth, monotone-decreasing curve in overall draft position — expected = a + b×ln(position), b never positive — over the startup and the 2021 vet draft as ONE sequence (the vet draft continues after the startup's last pick, the same ordering the pick-adjustment window uses). Each score then moves THREE QUARTERS of the way off its slot's expectation: adjusted = O-Score − 0.75 × (expected − mean O-Score), clamped to 0–100.
Notes: Three quarters, not all: fully removing the slope would call a 19th-round dart that missed blameless, which the data contradicts (deep startup rounds returned real value), while removing none blames the 1.07 bust no more than the 19.07 one. It ran at half strength when the de-trend first shipped; at 0.75 the startup's worst first-rounders all sit inside the bottom nine and the deep misses get the relief they are owed. Being a function of draft position only, it shifts whole regions of the draft and never reorders two picks made at the same slot. Does not apply to rookie_picks.
Equation (API stats only): clamp(O − 0.75 · ((α + β·ln n) − Ō), 0, 100),  n = overall pick number (startup then 2021 vet draft), (α, β) = least squares of O on ln n with β ≤ 0, Ō = mean O  — where clamp(v,a,b) = min(max(v,a),b)

Formula: Points-per-game the dropped player put up after you cut him — higher = worse drop. Mean NFL points over his next 17 PLAYED games from the drop date (fewer so far → averages what exists; a real 0 = never played again, and a negative total ranks below that).
Notes: Blank only when nothing was dropped.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ npts(r,y,w) : the first ≤ 17 games of GL(r) with gd ≥ d0 }; 0 if none

Formula: Total points the dropped player put up over those next 17 played games — higher = more given away. Same window as Dropped avg points.
Notes: Blank only when nothing was dropped.
Equation (API stats only): Σ{ npts(r,y,w) : the first ≤ 17 games of GL(r) with gd ≥ d0 }

Stat: KTC value difference at deal time
Formula: Which team won the deal's dynasty value on day one. Depth-adjusted KTC received − sent, superflex. DEPTH TAX: on each side the best asset counts full and each next is discounted (2nd ×0.6, 3rd ×0.6², …), since you can only start so many — so a 3-scrubs-for-1-stud package is taxed while a 1-for-1 is the raw difference. FAAB counts at a locked 100 KTC per $1.
Notes: Covers players, picks, and FAAB. Positive = this team won the deal. A pick KTC had no quote for on that date (late-2020 deals for 2021+ picks, before KTC priced picks) is estimated from the same pick one to three classes later at the same lead time before its draft, averaged (never a 2020 startup pick: a startup 4th is not a rookie 4th).
Equation (API stats only): DT(A, d0) − DT(B, d0),  DT(X,d) = Σ_i 0.6^(i−1)·K(X_(i), d) with K(X_(1)) ≥ K(X_(2)) ≥ …, a FAAB amount valued at κ·amount (κ = 100); a pick with no quote on d0 = the mean K of the same pick 1-3 classes later at the same lead time  — where DT(X,d) = Σ_i 0.6^(i−1)·K(X_(i), d), assets sorted by K descending; a FAAB amount valued at κ·amount

Stat: KTC value difference at end of season
Formula: The same depth-adjusted received − sent KTC gap, re-checked at this season's end (Monday after the championship) — how the deal looked once the season played out.
Notes: Superflex, depth-taxed. Future/pre-history dates are blank.
Equation (API stats only): DT(A, eos(y0)) − DT(B, eos(y0))  — where eos(y) = The Monday after season y's championship week; DT(X,d) = Σ_i 0.6^(i−1)·K(X_(i), d), assets sorted by K descending; a FAAB amount valued at κ·amount

Formula: The depth-adjusted received − sent KTC gap one year after the trade — who's ahead a year on.
Notes: Superflex, depth-taxed. Blank when still in the future.
Equation (API stats only): DT(A, d0+1y) − DT(B, d0+1y)  — where DT(X,d) = Σ_i 0.6^(i−1)·K(X_(i), d), assets sorted by K descending; a FAAB amount valued at κ·amount

Formula: The depth-adjusted received − sent KTC gap two years after the trade — the long-run verdict on who won.
Notes: Superflex, depth-taxed. Blank when still in the future.
Equation (API stats only): DT(A, d0+2y) − DT(B, d0+2y)  — where DT(X,d) = Σ_i 0.6^(i−1)·K(X_(i), d), assets sorted by K descending; a FAAB amount valued at κ·amount

Formula: How much draft-pick value this team brought in — highlights pick-heavy hauls. Σ KTC of just the picks received at deal time (players excluded).
Notes: Blank when no picks were received. Before KTC's pick history (2021-04-16) a pick is valued on that date instead; one with no quote even there is estimated from the same pick one to three classes later at the same lead time before its draft, averaged.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{pick ∈ dp(x), owner_id = t} K(pick, d0)

Stat: Change in pick value at draft time
Formula: Whether the received picks drew a better or worse slot than expected at the trade. For each unresolved pick received: KTC once it became a rookie (Sept 1 of its draft year) − KTC at deal time, summed.
Notes: Picks whose drafts are still in the future don't contribute. A pick KTC had no quote for on that date (late-2020 deals for 2021+ picks, before KTC priced picks) is estimated from the same pick one to three classes later at the same lead time before its draft, averaged.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{pick ∈ dp(x), owner_id = t, draft done} (K(pick, Sep 1 of its year) − K(pick, d0))

Formula: Of the assets received in this trade, those the team still holds today (never traded out or dropped to FA). Picks show as 'YYYY R.SLOT(F. Last)' once drafted.
Equation (API stats only): {q ∈ A : no x' with d(x') > d0 removing q from t}

Formula: Of the assets received in this trade, those it later moved on in another TRADE (rather than dropping to FA). Whichever exit came first decides.
Equation (API stats only): {q ∈ A : first exit of q from t after d0 is a trade}

Formula: Of the assets received in this trade, those it later DROPPED to free agency rather than trading. Picks excluded (picks can't be dropped).
Notes: From this team's later 'Player Dropped' entries after the trade date.
Equation (API stats only): {q ∈ A players : first exit of q from t after d0 is drops(x')[q] = t}

Formula: What this trade's haul turned into one hop later: the received side of the next trade(s) where the team gave up any asset from this haul.
Notes: Picks resolve to slot + drafted player where known, e.g. '2024 1.05(B. Robinson)'.
Equation (API stats only): ∪ {assets received by t in x'} over trades x' with d(x') > d0 where t sends some q ∈ A (first hop)

Stat: Additional assets traded away in those deals
Formula: The extra cost of converting the haul: other assets given up alongside it in those immediate-next trades.
Notes: Dedups across multiple downstream hops.
Equation (API stats only): ∪ {assets sent by t in x'} ∖ A over the same first-hop trades x'

Stat: Return from trades of trades...of trades. Keep going until present day
Formula: Everything this trade's haul eventually became, following each asset through every later trade to the present.
Notes: Picks display with their drafted player when known.
Equation (API stats only): closure: A_0 = A, A_{k+1} = ∪ received(x') over trades x' sending any q ∈ A_k; result = A_∞ at today

Formula: Whether the trade made the team younger or older — negative = younger. mean(received asset ages) − mean(sent asset ages) at the trade date. Players use birth_date; picks count as future rookies (aged ~21-22, so further-out picks are younger).
Notes: Reports 0 when one side has no aged asset (e.g. FAAB-only).
Equation (API stats only): mean_{q ∈ A} age*(q, d0) − mean_{q ∈ B} age*(q, d0),  age*(p,d) = age(p,d), age*(pick of year Y, d) = agepk(Y,d) = (d − Sep 1 of (Y − 22)) / 365.25; 0 if a side is empty  — where agepk(Y,d) = (d − Sep 1 of (Y − 22)) / 365.25; age*(q,d) = age(q,d) for a player; agepk(Y,d) for a season-Y pick

Formula: How many teams were in the trade — this team plus every counterparty. 2 for a normal swap, 3+ for a multi-team deal.
Equation (API stats only): |rosters(x)|

Stat: Link to next transaction per asset
Formula: For each asset RECEIVED (in 'Assets received' order), a clickable jump to that asset's NEXT event — '#N' add_drops, 'T#N' trades, 'PH#N' picks — as a ';'-joined list aligned 1:1. Players follow the player chain; picks follow their pick chain and stop at the draft row; FAAB is blank.
Notes: In the xlsx, exploded into one clickable column per received asset.
Equation (API stats only): for each q ∈ A: row of the first event x' (add/drop, trade or draft pick) on q with d(x') > d0

Stat: Link to previous transaction per asset
Formula: For each asset RECEIVED, a clickable jump to that asset's PREVIOUS event (same '#N' / 'T#N' / 'PH#N' scheme), ';'-joined 1:1. Built from the received side, so a trade's two mirror rows don't link to each other.
Notes: In the xlsx, exploded into one clickable column per received asset.
Equation (API stats only): for each q ∈ A: row of the last event x' on q with d(x') < d0

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Team's average age counting future draft picks as well as rostered players — so a team hoarding picks reads younger (the tank signal). Mean age over rostered players + held future picks that week; picks are aged as future rookies (~21-22). Year/all-time/league average the weekly values.
Notes: Feeds the tanking calculation in place of the rostered-only age.
Equation (API stats only): mean({age(p, dw(y,w)) : p ∈ R(t,w)} ∪ {agepk(Y, dw(y,w)) : picks held by t, Y ∈ next 3 drafts}); year/all-time/league = mean of the weekly values  — where agepk(Y,d) = (d − Sep 1 of (Y − 22)) / 365.25; dw(y,w) = Sep 1 of y + 7(w − 1)

Stat: Avg PPG of received players on team
Formula: Points per game the received side actually produced for this team. Each received player's 'Avg PPG on team' — the league's own points (player_week) per game he played while rostered here, from the trade to his next exit — averaged; a received pick counts the player drafted with it over his tenure here (only if this team made the pick and held it from this trade to the draft). A bye or a missed (injury/suspension) week is not a game.
Notes: A received player never rostered here for a week is left out; one rostered but who never played counts as 0. A not-yet-drafted or flipped pick contributes nothing. The same definition as 'Avg PPG on team' on add_drops, player_additions and the pick sheets.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{q ∈ A'} ppg_on(q, t, T_q),  A' = received players with Wk ≠ ∅ ∪ players drafted by t with a received pick held from d0 to the draft

Stat: Avg PPG of sent players over same time
Formula: What the sent side would have given you over the same span — each sent player's mean points per game (nflverse game log) from the trade until the last received player (or player drafted with a received pick) left this team, averaged. One still here keeps the span open to today. A player drafted with a received pick counts only if this team held the pick from this trade to the draft and he was rostered here for at least one week. With no such player (FAAB only, or received picks flipped, not yet drafted, or drafted but never rostered a week) it runs to today, but no more than 4 years after the trade.
Notes: A counterfactual — the sent players were not on this roster — so games anywhere count, unlike the received side's on-team PPG. The open-to-today span is by design: a received pick's payoff, incl. a later flip, has no end date.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{s ∈ B} ppg_nfl(s, [d0, e*)),  e* = last exit of A' from t (open → today; no A' → min(today, d0 + 4y))

Stat: Avg PPG of received players in 5 games before trade
Formula: The received players' recent form just before the trade. Each one's mean points over his 5 most-recent NFL games played on an earlier day than the trade (league/Eastern time; a Saturday trade does not count that Sunday's game), averaged (fewer than 5 → what's available).
Equation (API stats only): mean_{q ∈ A} avgN(q, d0, 5)

Formula: How much better the received side produced per game than the side given up, over the forward-looking window. Avg PPG of received players on team − Avg PPG of sent players over same time.
Notes: Positive = the received players out-scored the sent players. N/A when no received player was ever rostered for the team (picks/FAAB only, or the return never joined): with no received side there is nothing to compare. A received player rostered but never played counts as 0 PPG.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{q ∈ A'} ppg_on(q,t,T_q) − mean_{s ∈ B} ppg_nfl(s, [d0, e*)); N/A if A' = ∅

Stat: Difference of averages adjusted by position
Formula: The same received − sent PPG gap, but each side scaled for position so a cross-position trade is judged on positional value. Each PPG × (league starter avg / position avg).
Notes: N/A exactly where 'Difference of averages' is: no received player was ever rostered for the team.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{q ∈ A'} ppg_on(q,t,T_q)·F(y0,pos q) − mean_{s ∈ B} ppg_nfl(s,[d0,e*))·F(y0,pos s); N/A if A' = ∅

Formula: Overall grade of a trade for this team, mirroring the transaction 'Player addition value' plus a pick term. (Difference of averages adjusted by position) × (1 + the mean of the received players' own % of starts) × (1 + the mean of their own injury-adjusted % of starts, which drops injury and bye weeks but not suspension weeks) + 5 if any received player was a handcuff (the shared acquisition test — see 'Cuff at time of pickup?' on add_drops) + a future-pick term (received − sent picks, round-weighted like tanking and scaled so a future 1st ≈ +5).
Notes: Pick term counts every future pick in the deal, however far out (no season cap), and applies even to a pick-only haul; players drafted with received picks feed the PPG side.
Equation (API stats only): [mean_{A'} ppg_on(q,t,T_q)·F(y0,pos q) − mean_B ppg_nfl(s,[d0,e*))·F(y0,pos s)] · (1 + mean_{q ∈ A players} nst_q/|Wk_q|) · (1 + mean_{q ∈ A players} Σ_{Wk_q : ¬INJ ∧ ¬BYE} st / |{Wk_q : ¬INJ ∧ ¬BYE}|) + 5·[∃ q ∈ A : CUFF(q,t,d0)] + 20·(Σ_{picks recv} ω(round) − Σ_{picks sent} ω(round)) over every future pick in the deal (no horizon cap); pick term alone when no received player was rostered  — where ω(r) = {1: 0.25, 2: 0.09, 3: 0.03, 4: 0.01}, 0 otherwise

Formula: Points the received side put up in weeks it started for this team. Each week, sum the points of every received asset that STARTED (received players + players drafted with received picks).
Notes: Started weeks/points come from player_week.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{q ∈ A'} st(q,t,w) · pts(q,w)

Formula: The best plays you forwent: each week with k received starters, the points of the top-k players traded away that week (sent picks count the player drafted with them).
Notes: Counterfactual points from the nflverse game log; the top-k rule generalizes the 1-for-1 transaction Points Lost.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{top k_w s ∈ B by npts(s,y,w)} npts(s,y,w),  k_w = Σ_{q ∈ A'} st(q,t,w)

Formula: Net started-week production the deal gained this team. Points added − Points lost.
Notes: Positive = the received side out-produced the best-k sent assets.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w [Σ_{q ∈ A'} st(q,t,w)·pts(q,w) − Σ_{top k_w s ∈ B} npts(s,y,w)]

Formula: Points added per matched week (weeks with ≥1 received starter). Points added / matched weeks.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{A'} st·pts / M,  M = |{w : k_w ≥ 1}|

Formula: Points lost per matched week. Points lost / matched weeks.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{top k_w of B} npts / M

Formula: Net points per matched week. Net points / matched weeks.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w [Σ_{A'} st·pts − Σ_{top k_w of B} npts] / M

Stat: Avg points added adjusted by position
Formula: Avg points added with each received asset's points scaled for its position, so positions compare. Each × (league starter avg / position avg) before summing.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{q ∈ A'} st(q,t,w)·pts(q,w)·F(y_w,pos q) / M

Stat: Avg points lost adjusted by position
Formula: Avg points lost with each sent asset's points scaled for position. Keeps the same top-k assets (chosen by raw points), then sums their position-adjusted points.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w Σ_{top k_w s ∈ B by raw npts} npts(s,y,w)·F(y_w,pos s) / M

Stat: Avg net points adjusted by position
Formula: Position-normalised net of the deal. Avg points added adjusted by position − Avg points lost adjusted by position.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w [Σ_{A'} st·pts·F − Σ_{top k_w of B} npts·F] / M

Formula: The pick's 'round.slot' label in DRAFT ORDER (e.g. '1.05' = 5th pick of round 1). Snake drafts (2021 rookie) reverse even rounds; a future pick shows '2.??' until its season drafts.
Notes: Synthetic draft-day picks: '2.09' = the toilet-bracket reward (2024+); '5.01, 5.02, …' = the 20-FAAB draft-day buys (2025+). For slot comparisons 2.09 counts as 2.08 and each 5.0X as 4.08.
Equation (API stats only): round(pk) '.' (pick_no(pk) − (round(pk) − 1)·N), N = teams; '??' before the draft; 2.09 / 5.0X = synthetic award picks  — where round(pk) = round of draft pick pk (Sleeper /draft/{id}/picks → round); pick_no(pk) = overall pick number (Sleeper /draft/{id}/picks → pick_no)

Formula: The team that originally owned this pick before any trades — the team in that draft slot per Sleeper. For a traded pick, the chain's origin.
Notes: Distinct from 'Team'. ESPN-era picks fall back to the slot owner, else the picker.
Equation (API stats only): slot_to_roster_id(draft)[draft_slot(pk)] (= traded_picks.roster_id of the pick)  — where slot_to_roster_id = draft slot → original roster (Sleeper /draft/{id} → slot_to_roster_id)

Sheet: player_week / team_week / team_year / team_all_time / add_drops / trades / non_rookie_picks / rookie_picks
Formula: The team that actually MADE the selection (the last owner in the trade chain). Equals Original Team when the pick wasn't traded.
Notes: For 2021 rookie-draft even rounds (corrupt Sleeper data), repaired from who first rostered the drafted player.
Equation (API stats only): picked_by(pk) roster  (= traded_picks.owner_id at the draft)

Formula: How long the drafted player stayed on the team that drafted him, in days. Draft day (≈ Aug 28) to his next exit off that team, or to today if still rostered.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick; every made pick is ≥ 0 (an unmappable player falls back to 0).
Equation (API stats only): e − dd(Y),  e = first exit of pl(pk) from by(pk) after dd(Y), else today

Formula: Fantasy points per game the player produced for this team: the league's own points (player_week) over the games he played while rostered here — from draft day (picks) or the pickup (player_additions) to his next exit off that team (or today). A bye or a missed (injury/suspension) week is not a game.
Notes: Blank if he was never rostered here for an NFL week (or an unmade pick); 0 if rostered but never played. add_drops' 'Average PPG on team' is the same number.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(p, t, [s, e)) = Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H(p,w)} pts(p,w) / |{w ∈ Wk : H(p,w)}|,  s = dd(Y) (picks) or acquisition date (player_additions)

Stat: Avg PPG on team adjusted by position
Formula: Avg PPG on team scaled for position, so a 12-PPG TE isn't judged like a 12-PPG QB. × (league starter avg / position avg).
Notes: Blank / 0 exactly when Avg PPG on team is.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(pl, by, [dd, e)) · F(Y, pos(pl))

Formula: How the pick panned out overall: the drafted player's points per game across all his NFL games from the draft onward (every team, not just the drafter). Vets count only post-draft games.
Notes: 0 for a made pick whose player never played post-draft; blank only for an unmade pick. nflverse coverage is 2021+.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ npts(pl,y,w) : APP(pl,y,w), gd ≥ dd(Y) }; 0 if none

Stat: Avg career PPG adjusted by position
Formula: Avg career PPG scaled for position. × (league starter avg / position avg).
Notes: Blank / 0 exactly when Avg career PPG is.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ npts(pl,y,w) : APP, gd ≥ dd(Y) } · F(Y, pos(pl))

Formula: How old the player a pick became was on draft day. Age in decimal years at the draft anchor (≈ Aug 28), from birth_date.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick or a player with no birth_date.
Equation (API stats only): age(pl, dd(Y)) = (dd(Y) − birth(pl)) / 365.25

Formula: Overall grade of the pick, like the add/drop version but with no 'dropped' side. (Avg PPG on team adjusted by position) × (1 + starts before the next transaction / 170) × (1 + % of starts made while rostered by drafting team) × (1 + injury-adjusted % of starts) + 5 if Cuff when drafted?.
Notes: Blank when the player never played an NFL week for the drafter, or for an unmade pick. The two % terms are RATES — how often he started, not for how long — so the starts term carries the LENGTH of the run: 170 is roughly a decade of starts, so the factor is 1.0 for a pick that never started and stays at or under 1.2 for 90% of picks; the longest run in the data (95 starts) reaches 1.56. It scales the PPG term only; the handcuff bonus is added after. Picks only — the add_drops, trades and player_additions versions are unchanged.
Equation (API stats only): ppg_on(pl,by,[dd,e))·F(Y,pos pl) · (1 + nst/170) · (1 + nst/|Wk|) · (1 + nstH/nH) + 5·[CUFF(pl, by, dd)]  — where nst = Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st(p,t,w); nH = |{w ∈ Wk : H(p,w)}|; nstH = Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H(p,w)} st(p,t,w)

Formula: Was the pick a handcuff? TRUE when, at the moment of the move, the adding team already rosters another player on the SAME NFL team and position (the reference) who either averages 10+ PPG more than the added player, or averages 13+ PPG as a TE (other positions: the position-adjusted equivalent, reference PPG x position factor >= 13 x the TE factor), or was a top-12 pick in that season's rookie draft. Both averages are the reference's last 8 PLAYED NFL games (nflverse, league scoring) before the move; the added player's own average is his last 8 (or fewer). 8 is a hard cutoff: a reference with fewer than 8 games counts only through the draft test. For a pick, 'the move' is the draft: the roster as it opened plus the team's earlier picks in it; a rookie draft is itself that season's draft, so its earlier top-12 picks count.
Notes: The draft test uses the rookie draft of the move's season only once it has happened; before it, there is no draft test. 2020 had no rookie draft, so its test is the first 12 NFL rookies taken in the startup; 2021 uses the rookie draft, not the vet draft. One definition on add_drops, trades (inside Trade addition value), the pick sheets and player_additions. player_week's '- Activated Cuff?' and the team/league 'Number of cuffs rostered|started' apply the same test week by week. A rookie's NFL team is his first NFL game's. Feeds Player addition value.
Equation (API stats only): CUFF(pl, by, dd(Y))  (reference roster = R(by) at draft open ∪ by's earlier picks in that draft)

Formula: How many weeks the drafted player sat on the drafting team's roster before his first start for them.
Notes: Blank if he never started for the drafter (or an unmade pick).
Equation (API stats only): |{w ∈ Wk : w < w*}|, w* = min{w ∈ Wk : st(pl,by,w) = 1}  — where w* = min St (or the first started tenure week)

Stat: Number of starts before next transaction
Formula: How many weeks the drafted player started for the drafting team before leaving it (trade/drop).
Notes: ≥ 0 for every made pick (0 if he never started); blank for an unmade pick.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk(pl, by, [dd,e))} st(pl,by,w)

Stat: % of starts made while rostered by drafting team
Formula: Share of his rostered weeks the drafted player started for the drafting team. starts / weeks rostered over the post-draft tenure.
Notes: Blank if never rostered an NFL week here; 0 if rostered but never started.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st(pl,by,w) / |Wk|

Stat: Injury adjusted % of starts made while rostered by drafting team
Formula: Start rate for the drafting team counting only weeks he was available. starts / rostered weeks, both excluding injury/bye weeks.
Notes: Blank when there were no injury-free rostered weeks (or an unmade pick).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H} st(pl,by,w) / |{w ∈ Wk : H(pl,w)}|

Formula: Points the drafted player put up in the weeks he STARTED for the drafting team. Summed over the post-draft tenure window.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick; ≥ 0 for every made pick.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st(pl,by,w) · pts(pl,w)

Formula: Points added per started week. Points added / started weeks for this team.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick; 0 for a made pick with no starts.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{Wk} st·pts / Σ_{Wk} st  (0 if no start)

Stat: Avg points added adjusted by position
Formula: Avg points added scaled for position. Each started week's points × (league starter avg / position avg), then / started weeks.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick; 0 for a made pick with no starts.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{Wk} st·pts·F(y_w,pos pl) / Σ_{Wk} st

Formula: TRUE when this pick changed owners outside a normal recorded trade — the pick belongs to a non-original owner but no trade event explains the move (typical for picks moved beyond Sleeper's ~3-year window).
Notes: Such picks aren't added to trades.csv; assumed a single move from original to current owner.
Equation (API stats only): [owner_id(pick) ≠ roster_id(pick) ∧ no trade x with pick ∈ dp(x)]

Formula: How many times the pick changed hands by trade — recorded Sleeper trades plus off-platform commissioner moves the commissioner re-applied by hand.
Notes: The full ownership lineage lives in the hover-comment on the pick's first cell. The award picks (2.09 reward, 5.xx buy) count 0 for the award itself, then count every onward trade. 2020 startup picks were tradeable off-platform: six of them moved in the draft-day slot swap and count 1.
Equation (API stats only): |{x : type(x) = trade, pick ∈ dp(x)}| + |{CPM moves of pick}|  — where CPM = Hand-curated off-platform commissioner pick moves (data/commissioner_pick_trades.csv)

Formula: Clickable jump to the drafted PLAYER's first move after the draft ('#N' transaction or 'T#N' trade). The draft row starts his player chain.
Notes: Blank for an unmade pick or a player with no post-draft events.
Equation (API stats only): row of argmin_{x'} {d(x') > dd(Y) : pl ∈ adds ∪ drops ∪ trade assets(x')}

Formula: Clickable jump to the PICK's last trade before the draft ('T#N'). The draft row ends the pick's trade chain.
Notes: Blank for an unmade or never-traded pick.
Equation (API stats only): row of argmax_{x} {d(x) < dd(Y) : type = trade, pick ∈ dp(x)}

Sheet: add_drops / trades / all add/drop & trade counts
Formula: A single-day commissioner correction that leaves a roster exactly as it started is dropped entirely. Triggered when every player moved nets to zero on its roster within one calendar day and a commissioner action was involved.
Notes: Covers commissioner add+drop, same-day re-adds, undone adds, and reversed trades. Excluded from every transaction/trade count and detail.
Equation (API stats only): drop the tx set X if ∃ commissioner tx in X ∧ ∀ (p, roster): Σ_{x ∈ X, same ET day} ([adds(x)[p] = roster] − [drops(x)[p] = roster]) = 0  (trades: every asset returns)

Formula: The player's real NFL team that week. Resolved in order: nflverse week stats → season stats → weekly roster (catches IR/suspended/PUP players with no stats) → the sentinel 'NFL' only if he had no roster at all that season (free agent / retired). Team DSTs and unmapped players keep Sleeper's team.
Notes: A player on the 'NFL' sentinel is never flagged on bye (no schedule).
Equation (API stats only): nfl(p,y,w) = teamN(p,y,w) → teamN(p,y,·) season → wr(p,y,w).team → 'NFL'

Formula: When his NFL team played that week, by kickoff (ET): Thursday / Friday / Saturday (Wednesday for a Christmas game before Sunday), Sunday morning (before 1 pm — international games), Sunday early (1 pm), Sunday late (4 pm), SNF (Sunday 7 pm or later), MNF, then Tuesday / Wednesday for a game after Monday (2020's COVID makeups). Bye when his team had no game; N/A on the 'NFL' sentinel.
Notes: Bench rows too. Kickoffs from the nflverse schedule; the abandoned 2022 Bills-Bengals week 17 game (the Damar Hamlin no-contest), struck from it, is kept as the Monday night game it was — byes and game days see it too. lotg_support.gametime.
Equation (API stats only): slot(ko(nfl(p,y,w),y,w)) by ET weekday and hour, relative to the week's Sunday: before Sunday → weekday; Sunday <13 morning, <16 early, <19 late, else SNF; after Sunday → MNF (Monday) / weekday; no game → Bye; nfl = 'NFL' → N/A  — where ko(team,y,w) = Kickoff (ET date and time) of the NFL team's week-w game; none = bye (nflverse schedules games.csv → gameday + gametime)

Formula: TRUE when a handcuff had to start: he STARTED this week, the team rosters a same-NFL-team, same-position teammate who averages 10+ PPG more than him, or 13+ PPG as a TE (other positions: the position-adjusted equivalent), or was a top-12 pick in that season's rookie draft — the same handcuff test as 'Cuff at time of pickup?', judged against that week's roster at its first kickoff, averages over each player's last 8 played NFL games before the week (8 a hard cutoff for the teammate), and one of those qualifying teammates is injured this week.
Notes: Drives 'Number of cuffs started' and halves the Cuff adjusted difference. The hurt teammate needn't have been a starter.
Equation (API stats only): st(p,t,w) ∧ ∃ q ∈ R(t,w_kick): nfl(q)=nfl(p), pos(q)=pos(p), TEST(q,p,w) ∧ INJ(q,w)  — where w_kick = the roster as of week w's first game

Formula: Whether starting this player was the right call. His points − the highest-scoring bench player who could have started instead.
Notes: Negative = a benched player out-scored him (bad call).
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − max{ pts(b,w) : b ∈ R(t,w)∖S(t,w), b eligible for some slot p could vacate }

Formula: For a bench player: his points − the weakest starter he could have replaced. Positive = he should have played.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − min{ pts(s,w) : s ∈ S(t,w), p eligible for slot(s) }  (empty slot = 0)

Formula: How hard a team is tanking: high when it under-scores the league while stockpiling young players and draft picks. Weekly average of five 0-1 signals — below-league PF, below-league Max PF, young roster (incl. picks), this year's picks, and future draft capital. team_year = the final week's value; team_all_time = mean of seasons.
Notes: PF/age signals are season-to-date. Never summed across weeks (each value is already a running average).
Equation (API stats only): (1/6)(1 − (P̄F_t − ⅔L̄)/(L̄/3)) + (1/6)(1 − (M̄ax_t − L̄)/(L̄max − L̄)) + (1/6)(1 − (Āge_t − 21)/(L̄age − 21)) + (1/6)·Σ_{pk : by(pk) = t, draft of y} 1/(pick_no(pk) + 1) + (1/9)·Σ_{picks held, seasons y+1 … y+5} ω(round); P̄F_t, M̄ax_t, Āge_t = t's season-to-date means of PF, MaxPF and team age incl. picks, L̄ = league means; team_year = the final week's value, team_all_time = mean of seasons  — where pick_no(pk) = overall pick number (Sleeper /draft/{id}/picks → pick_no); ω(r) = {1: 0.25, 2: 0.09, 3: 0.03, 4: 0.01}, 0 otherwise

Formula: How lucky or unlucky a team's result was, given how it and its opponent actually played — rewards unlucky losses / strong-but-beaten weeks, penalizes lucky wins. Weekly composite of: beating (or missing) a pregame talent estimate, the opponent collapsing or your studs popping (counted only when the game was close), a heavy penalty for injuries/byes, plus efficiency, close-game and bad-beat terms and an extra hit when hurt starters cost a winnable game. team_year Luck = sum of weekly Luck; team_all_time 'Avg yearly luck' = mean of the season totals.
Notes: Calibrated so winning to your talent nets ≈ 0; each loss-from-hardship week subtracts 0.25. All-time averages seasons (not weeks) to stay fair across tenures. Full weighting in plan/LUCK_REWORK.md.
Equation (API stats only): Luck(t,w) = (0.27·OUT + 0.14·SIS − 0.14·BROS)·(1.8 if stage(t,w) ∈ PO else 1) + (0.36·OPP + 0.10·OWN)·GATE − 0.36·ADV + 0.12·EFF + 0.16·CLOSE − 0.25·LFH; OUT = win(t,w) − 1/(1 + e^(−1.5·δ)), δ = ⅓[z_all(μMax_t − μMax_o) + z_all(μPF_t − μPF_o) + z_all(μwin_t − μwin_o)] (z_all over every team-week row), OPP = z_wk(−(PA(t,w) − μPF_o)), OWN = z_wk(PF(t,w) − μPF_t), ADV = z_wk(Hard + SAHard + 3·Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} BYE(p,w)), EFF = z_wk(PF/MaxPF), CLOSE = sgn(m)·max(0, 1 − |m|/8), GATE = 1/(1 + |m|/15), m = PF − PA; 0 with no opponent; team_year = Σ_w Luck(t,w), team_all_time 'Avg yearly luck' = mean over seasons of Σ_w Luck  — where z_wk = clip((v − mean_{y,w} v) / sd_{y,w} v, ±2.5) / 2.5 within each league week; z_all = (v − mean v) / sd v over all rows; SIS = ⟨Sisenzweig⟩(t,w); BROS = ⟨Brosenzweig⟩(t,w); LFH = ⟨Loss from hardship?⟩(t,w); Hard = ⟨Hardship⟩(t,w); SAHard = ⟨Starter-adjusted Hardship⟩(t,w); μPF, μMax, μwin = means of PF, MaxPF, win over all of t's games in season y (subscript o: the opponent's)

Formula: Fantasy points a team lost to injury/suspension that week. Sum, over every rostered player who missed to injury or suspension (starter or bench, not a bye), of his expected-if-healthy points (recent scoring baseline, floored at 0). Year/all-time/league sum the weekly values.
Notes: Higher = more production knocked out (not schedule strength). Byes never count. 'Starter-adjusted Hardship' weights each by likelihood of starting; both feed Luck.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} [pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ (INJ ∨ SUS) ∧ ¬BYE] · max(0, E_h(p,w)); year/all-time/league = Σ

Formula: -1 × (standings_place − (pf_place + maxpf_place) / 2).
Notes: Negative when a team finishes better than their PF / Max PF percentile would predict (over-performance via luck or close-game wins).
Equation (API stats only): −(rank_stand(t,y) − (rank_ΣPF(t,y) + rank_ΣMaxPF(t,y)) / 2)  — where rank_X = rank by X, 1 = highest

Formula: Sample-size-shrunk WEIGHTED mean O-Score of the picks the team MADE (the roster that made the selection, formerly 'Final Team'): skill = (Σw·O + 5·50)/(Σw + 5), pulled toward the league-neutral 50. A rookie pick weighs 1; a non_rookie_picks pick (2020 startup / 2021 vet) weighs 0.5. Per (Team, Year) and all-time.
Notes: Higher = better drafting. The shrinkage keeps a 2-great-pick manager from out-ranking a 25-solid one. Non-rookie picks count HALF because they are scored in a different percentile universe and there are nearly as many of them (184) as there are rookie picks (204) — at full weight the one-off startup would outvote six rookie drafts. They still count: it is still drafting. This lands on team_all_time and on team_year 2021 (the vet draft); the startup's Year is the non-numeric 'startup' tag, so it reaches the all-time grade only. Blank with no made picks; blank-O-Score picks (an unmade pick, or a rookie class before week 8) drop out of the mean.
Equation (API stats only): (Σ_i ν_i·⟨O-Score⟩_i + 5·50) / (Σ_i ν_i + 5) over the picks t made, ν = 1 rookie pick, 0.5 startup / 2021 vet pick

Formula: Sample-size-shrunk mean O-Score of the trades the team was in (trades.Team): skill = (n·mean + 5·50)/(n+5).
Notes: Higher = better trading. Blank with no trades; one-sided / untracked trades with a blank O-Score drop out.
Equation (API stats only): (Σ_{trade rows of t} ⟨O-Score⟩_i + 5·50) / (n + 5)

Formula: Sample-size-shrunk WEIGHTED-mean O-Score of the team's waiver/FA add/drops (add_drops.Team): skill = (Σw·O-Score + 5·50)/(Σw + 5). Adds and swaps carry weight 1; pure drops (drop-only rows) carry weight 1/3, so they still register but a flurry of drops can't dominate.
Notes: Higher = better pickups. Blank with no add/drops. Pure-drop moves ARE included, weighted 1/3 vs adds/swaps; only blank-O-Score moves drop out entirely.
Equation (API stats only): (Σ_i ν_i·⟨O-Score⟩_i + 5·50) / (Σ_i ν_i + 5) over t's add_drops rows, ν = 1 add / swap, ⅓ pure drop

Formula: Schedule-luck-free win rate: each week, score the team against EVERY other team (not just its actual opponent). Win % = (Σ over weeks of teams with strictly lower PF that week) / (Σ over weeks of other teams). Per (Team, Year) on team_year; pooled over all weeks on team_all_time. Ties count as neither a win nor a loss but stay in the denominator (so they depress the rate). Format 0–1, 4 decimals like Win %.
Notes: Reveals true scoring strength independent of who you were scheduled against — a team can be top-half (the existing flag) yet have a mediocre all-play %, or vice versa. Blank for a (team, year) with no games (e.g. the not-yet-played current/future season).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w |{u ≠ t : PF(u,w) < PF(t,w)}| / Σ_w (N_w − 1)  — where N_w = |{t : o(t,w) defined}|

Formula: All-play win % − actual Win % (team_all_time uses 'All time win %'). Positive = the team's actual record UNDER-shot its all-play scoring strength (unlucky schedule / lost close games); negative = the record OVER-shot it (lucky schedule / won close games).
Notes: A compact schedule-luck read. Blank when all-play % is blank (no games).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w |{u ≠ t : PF(u,w) < PF(t,w)}| / Σ_w (N_w − 1) − Σ_w win(t,w) / |{w}|  — where N_w = |{t : o(t,w) defined}|

Formula: Clutch index (PF): the team's average points-for per game in the championship-bracket Semifinal and Final games minus its average in the regular season, all-time. Positive = raises their scoring in the playoffs.
Notes: team_all_time only (#9). Blank for a team that never reached a Semifinal. 3rd Place and the toilet bracket count as neither playoff nor regular season.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{w : stage ∈ PO} PF(t,w) − mean_{w ∈ REG} PF(t,w)

Formula: Clutch index (win %): the team's win rate in championship-bracket Semifinal and Final games (the 'Playoff win %' games) minus its regular-season win rate, all-time. Positive = wins more in the playoffs.
Notes: team_all_time only (#9). Blank for a team that never reached a Semifinal. 3rd Place and the toilet bracket count as neither.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{w : stage ∈ PO} win(t,w) − mean_{w ∈ REG} win(t,w)

Formula: TRUE when a LOSS would have flipped to a win had the team's hurt would-be-starters been available. Build a lineup from the ACTUAL STARTERS (real points) PLUS the injured/suspended players who missed (subbed in at their starter-adjusted hardship value), take the best valid lineup (bounded to lineup slots), and flag if that score beats the opponent's actual PF.
Notes: Healthy BENCH players are excluded — this asks 'what if their hurt guys were available', not 'what if they'd start/sat optimally'. Injury + suspension, never byes. Each flagged week also subtracts 0.25 from that week's Luck.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 0 ∧ OPT({pts(p,w) : p ∈ S(t,w)} ∪ {max(0,E_h(q,w))·s_h(q,w) : q ∈ R(t,w), pts=0, INJ ∨ SUS, s_h > 0}, y) > PA(t,w)]

Formula: Count of 'Loss from hardship?' weeks per (Team, Year) / per Team all-time.
Notes: Blank for a (team, year) with no games; a real 0 stays 0.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Loss from hardship?⟩(t,w)

Formula: The bye analog of 'Loss from hardship?', but SYMMETRIC across the matchup: TRUE when a LOSS would have flipped to a win in a world where NEITHER team had byes. For each team compute a bye GAIN = optimal(actual starters + its on-bye would-be-starters at their starter-adjusted bye value) − optimal(actual starters); add each side's gain to its ACTUAL score, and flag when this team's PF + its bye gain beats the opponent's PF + the opponent's bye gain.
Notes: Unlike 'Loss from hardship?' (a one-sided injury counterfactual vs the opponent's raw PF), a bye is a shared schedule artifact — so both teams get their on-bye would-be-starters back, not just one. The gain is a delta added to actual PF, so a gap between PF and summed player points on either side (e.g. the home-field-advantage bonus) can't manufacture a flip, and a bye-free week (0 gain both sides) reduces to PF vs PA. Bench players are excluded. Bye only, never injury/suspension.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 0 ∧ PF(t,w) + G_bye(t,w) > PA(t,w) + G_bye(o,w)], G_bye(t,w) = OPT(S(t,w) pts ∪ {max(0,E_h(q,w))·s_h(q,w) : q ∈ R, pts = 0, BYE(q,w)}) − OPT(S(t,w) pts)

Formula: Count of 'Loss from bye?' weeks per (Team, Year) / per Team all-time.
Notes: Blank for a (team, year) with no games; a real 0 stays 0.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Loss from bye?⟩(t,w)

Formula: The SYMMETRIC 'no-injury world' analog of 'Loss from bye?', for injuries/suspensions: TRUE when a LOSS would have flipped to a win once BOTH teams are healed. For each team compute a hardship GAIN = optimal(actual starters + its injured/suspended would-be-starters at their starter-adjusted hardship value) − optimal(actual starters); add each side's gain to its ACTUAL score, and flag when this team's PF + its gain beats the opponent's PF + the opponent's gain.
Notes: Differs from the one-sided 'Loss from hardship?' (which heals only this team vs the opponent's raw PF). Bench players excluded. Injury + suspension, never byes.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 0 ∧ PF + G_h(t,w) > PA + G_h(o,w)], G_h(t,w) = OPT(S pts ∪ {max(0,E_h)·s_h : q ∈ R, pts = 0, INJ ∨ SUS}) − OPT(S pts)

Formula: The mirror of 'Loss from hardship (2-sided)?': TRUE when a WIN would have flipped to a LOSS once BOTH teams are healed of injuries/suspensions — this team's PF + its hardship gain falls short of the opponent's PF + the opponent's hardship gain.
Notes: A win gifted by the opponent sitting more injured/suspended starter value than this team. Injury + suspension, never byes.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 1 ∧ PF + G_h(t,w) < PA + G_h(o,w)]

Formula: Count of 'Loss from hardship (2-sided)?' weeks per (Team, Year) / per Team all-time.
Notes: Blank for a (team, year) with no games; a real 0 stays 0. The two-sided complement to the one-sided 'Losses from hardship'.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Loss from hardship (2-sided)?⟩(t,w)

Formula: Count of 'Win from hardship (2-sided)?' weeks per (Team, Year) / per Team all-time — i.e. how many of the team's wins would be losses in a two-sided no-injury world.
Notes: Blank for a (team, year) with no games; a real 0 stays 0.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Win from hardship (2-sided)?⟩(t,w)

Formula: The mirror of 'Loss from bye?': TRUE when a WIN would have flipped to a LOSS once BOTH teams' on-bye would-be-starters are restored — this team's PF + its bye gain falls short of the opponent's PF + the opponent's bye gain.
Notes: Symmetric like 'Loss from bye?'. A win gifted by the opponent sitting more bye-week starter value than this team. Bye only, never injury/suspension.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 1 ∧ PF + G_bye(t,w) < PA + G_bye(o,w)]

Formula: Count of 'Win from bye?' weeks per (Team, Year) / per Team all-time — i.e. how many of the team's wins would be losses in a no-bye world.
Notes: Blank for a (team, year) with no games; a real 0 stays 0.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Win from bye?⟩(t,w)

Formula: Standard deviation of the player's points over his STARTED weeks only (bench weeks excluded).
Notes: Blank for a player who never started, and with fewer than 2 started weeks. player_year per season; player_all_time pools every started week.
Equation (API stats only): sd{ pts(p,w) : st(p,·,w) = 1 }  (sample sd, ≥ 2 weeks)

Formula: The lowest single started-week points the player scored (absolute minimum over started weeks, not a percentile).
Notes: Blank for a player who never started.
Equation (API stats only): min{ pts(p,w) : st(p,·,w) = 1 }

Formula: The highest single started-week points the player scored (absolute maximum over started weeks).
Notes: Blank for a player who never started.
Equation (API stats only): max{ pts(p,w) : st(p,·,w) = 1 }

Formula: Share of the player's ACTIVE started weeks whose score landed in the BOOM tier — the top 10% (>= p90) of the ALL-TIME pooled distribution of active starter scores for that player's position (each week judged against its own position's bars). Position-relative, so it's comparable across positions.
Notes: The 5 Starter tier shares (boom / upper quartile / middle 50% / lower quartile / bust) sum to ~100%. Keeps a real 0 for a player who started but never boomed; blank if he never had an active start.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : st ∧ H(p,w), pts(p,w) ≥ q90(Q_pos)}| / |{w : st ∧ H}|,  Q_q = {pts(p',w') : st, H, pos(p') = q, all seasons}

Formula: Share of the player's active started weeks in the UPPER-QUARTILE tier — between the position's p75 and p90 all-time starter scores (above the middle 50%, below a boom).
Notes: Part of the 5-tier positional split; blank with no active starts.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : st ∧ H, q75(Q_pos) ≤ pts < q90(Q_pos)}| / |{w : st ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of the player's active started weeks in the MIDDLE-50% tier — between the position's p25 and p75 all-time starter scores (the interquartile range).
Notes: Part of the 5-tier positional split; blank with no active starts.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : st ∧ H, q25(Q_pos) ≤ pts < q75(Q_pos)}| / |{w : st ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of the player's active started weeks in the LOWER-QUARTILE tier — between the position's p10 and p25 all-time starter scores (below the middle 50%, above a bust).
Notes: Part of the 5-tier positional split; blank with no active starts.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : st ∧ H, q10(Q_pos) < pts < q25(Q_pos)}| / |{w : st ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of the player's ACTIVE started weeks whose score landed in the BUST tier — the bottom 10% (<= p10) of the position's all-time pooled active-starter scores.
Notes: Position-relative (a TE bust bar sits lower than a QB's). Keeps a real 0 for a player who started but never busted; blank if he never had an active start.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : st ∧ H, pts ≤ q10(Q_pos)}| / |{w : st ∧ H}|

Equation (API stats only): pctl(−sd_st(p) ; {−sd_st(p') : p' same pos (and season on player_year)}),  sd_st(p) = sd{pts(p,w) : st}

Formula: Position-adjusted league-wide percentile of Starter scoring floor — the highest floor at the position = 100.

Formula: Points Above Replacement summed over started weeks. Each week the replacement level = the mean of the BOTTOM THIRD of that week's STARTED scores at the player's position; PAR_week = his points − that level; Starter PAR = the Σ.
Notes: Value over a freely-startable option, week by week. Blank for a player who never started.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : st(p,·,w)} (pts(p,w) − RL(pos p, w)),  RL(q,w) = mean of the lowest ⌈⅓⌉ of {pts(p',w) : st(p',·,w), pos(p') = q}  — where RL(q,w) = mean of the lowest third of {pts(p,w) : st, pos(p) = q} in week w

Formula: The mean (not sum) of the per-started-week PAR — average points above a last-startable replacement.
Notes: Blank for a player who never started.
Equation (API stats only): mean_{w : st(p,·,w)} (pts(p,w) − RL(pos p, w))  — where RL(q,w) = mean of the lowest third of {pts(p,w) : st, pos(p) = q} in week w

Formula: Standard deviation of the player's points over every week he actually PLAYED while rostered — started OR benched — excluding bye/injury/suspension weeks.

Equation (API stats only): sd{ pts(p,w) : ro(p,·,w) ∧ H(p,w) }  (≥ 2 weeks)

Formula: The lowest single played-while-rostered week's points (started or benched; non-played weeks excluded).
Notes: Blank with no played weeks.
Equation (API stats only): min{ pts(p,w) : ro ∧ H }

Formula: The highest single played-while-rostered week's points (started or benched).
Notes: Blank with no played weeks.

Notes: The 5 Rostered tier shares sum to ~100%. Real 0 if he played but never boomed; blank with no played weeks.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro ∧ H, pts ≥ q90(Q_pos)}| / |{w : ro ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of played-while-rostered weeks in the UPPER-QUARTILE tier (position p75-p90), same bars as the Starter version but over every played week, started or benched.
Notes: Part of the 5-tier positional split; blank with no played weeks.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro ∧ H, q75(Q_pos) ≤ pts < q90(Q_pos)}| / |{w : ro ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of played-while-rostered weeks in the MIDDLE-50% tier (position p25-p75 interquartile range).
Notes: Part of the 5-tier positional split; blank with no played weeks.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro ∧ H, q25(Q_pos) ≤ pts < q75(Q_pos)}| / |{w : ro ∧ H}|

Formula: Share of played-while-rostered weeks in the LOWER-QUARTILE tier (position p10-p25).

Formula: Share of played-while-rostered weeks (started OR benched) whose score landed in the BUST tier — bottom 10% (<= p10) of the position's all-time pooled active-starter scores.
Notes: Position-relative. Real 0 if he played but never busted; blank with no played weeks.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro ∧ H, pts ≤ q10(Q_pos)}| / |{w : ro ∧ H}|

Formula: Where the week's score places (0-100) within the ALL-TIME pooled distribution of ACTIVE starter scores for the player's position — percent of that position's starter weeks scoring at or below this week. Drives the 5 scoring tiers (Bust <= p10, Lower quartile p10-p25, Middle 50% p25-p75, Upper quartile p75-p90, Boom >= p90).
Notes: Blank on bye / injury / suspension weeks (a 0 there isn't a real score), and for a position with no reference starter scores.
Equation (API stats only): 100 · |{v ∈ Q_pos(p) : v ≤ pts(p,w)}| / |Q_pos(p)|; blank if ¬H(p,w)

Formula: All-time running count of consecutive STARTED weeks whose Positional scoring percentile put the player in that tier (Boom / Upper quartile / Middle 50% / Lower quartile / Bust). Terminal-encoded like the other player streaks: the length shows on the run's final week, 'In Progress' before, 0 on a started week in a different tier.
Notes: Bye / injury / suspension weeks — and benched weeks — are skipped (the run bridges across them; those cells read blank). Spans seasons.
Equation (API stats only): RUN over p's weeks with st ∧ H (others skipped) of [tier(pts(p,w)) = τ], tier from q10/q25/q75/q90 of Q_pos  — where qN = The N-th percentile of Q_q (q10, q25, q75, q90); tier = Bust ≤ q10 < Lower < q25 ≤ Middle < q75 ≤ Upper < q90 ≤ Boom; τ = τ ∈ {Boom, Upper, Middle, Lower, Bust}

Formula: Like the Starter tier streaks but over every PLAYED week (started OR benched): consecutive played weeks in that positional scoring tier, terminal-encoded.
Notes: Bye / injury / suspension weeks are skipped (blank; the run bridges them). Spans seasons.
Equation (API stats only): RUN over p's weeks with ro ∧ H (others skipped) of [tier(pts(p,w)) = τ]  — where qN = The N-th percentile of Q_q (q10, q25, q75, q90); tier = Bust ≤ q10 < Lower < q25 ≤ Middle < q75 ≤ Upper < q90 ≤ Boom; τ = τ ∈ {Boom, Upper, Middle, Lower, Bust}

Stat: % of starters in each positional scoring tier
Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Share of ACTIVE starters whose score fell in each of the 5 positional scoring tiers — on the team sheets over the TEAM's starters, on the league sheets over EVERY team's starters league-wide — that week (…_week), pooled over the season (…_year), or pooled all-time (…_all_time). Each starter is judged against its own position's all-time starter-score bars; the 5 shares sum to ~100%.
Notes: Bye / injury / suspension starts are excluded (no real score). Blank for a week/period with no active starters.
Equation (API stats only): |{(p,w) : p ∈ S(t,w), H(p,w), tier(pts(p,w)) = τ}| / |{(p,w) : p ∈ S(t,w), H}|  (league sheets: over all t; year/all-time: pooled)  — where qN = The N-th percentile of Q_q (q10, q25, q75, q90); tier = Bust ≤ q10 < Lower < q25 ≤ Middle < q75 ≤ Upper < q90 ≤ Boom; τ = τ ∈ {Boom, Upper, Middle, Lower, Bust}

Formula: Position-adjusted league-wide percentile of Rostered scoring volatility INVERTED (steadiest = 100), ranked like the Starter percentiles.
