Formula: Consecutive seasons with a .500+ REGULAR season (Regular season record: wins + ½ ties ≥ half the regular-season games). ALL-TIME and terminal-encoded like the weekly streaks.
Notes: A regular season still being played counts once it is decided: clinched (.500 reached even losing out) extends the streak, out of reach (even winning out) breaks it; until then the season reads N/A and leaves the streak alone, so a completed season's value cannot flip week to week. Regular-season games = playoff-start week − 1 (2020: 14, 2021-2025: 15, 2026+: 14). Playoff and consolation games do not count.
Equation (API stats only): RUN over seasons y of [Σ_{w ∈ REG} win(t,w) ≥ (pws(y) − 1)/2]  (in progress: clinched → 1, out of reach → 0, else N/A)

Formula: Across all opponents this team has actually played (≥1 all-time game), the maximum of its 'Win % vs <opponent>'.
Notes: Opponents never played are excluded. 'Team for highest Win %' holds the matching opponent.
Equation (API stats only): max_{o : n(t,o) ≥ 1} Σ_{w : o(t,w) = o} win(t,w) / n(t,o)

Formula: Across all opponents actually played, the minimum 'Win % vs <opponent>'.
Notes: Opponents never played are excluded so 'lowest' isn't trivially 0.
Equation (API stats only): min_{o : n(t,o) ≥ 1} Σ_{w : o(t,w) = o} win(t,w) / n(t,o)

Formula: The opponent handle against whom this team's all-time Win % is highest.
Notes: Links to that team's team_all_time row in the xlsx.
Equation (API stats only): argmax_{o : n(t,o) ≥ 1} Σ_{o(t,w)=o} win / n(t,o)

Formula: The opponent handle against whom this team's all-time Win % is lowest.
Notes: Among opponents actually played.
Equation (API stats only): argmin_{o : n(t,o) ≥ 1} Σ_{o(t,w)=o} win / n(t,o)

Formula: team_week: 1 if the team won while its Enhanced Projection was 9 or more points below the opponent's (an upset win); else 0. League sheets sum those flags (week = upsets that week; year/all-time = total upsets).
Notes: Switched from the pregame avg Max PF (a win while it was below the opponent's, weeks 4+ only) to the Enhanced projection [per user, 2026-10-07: 'switch this to enhanced, with a 8-10 point threshold'] — underdogs projected 8, 9 or 10+ points behind all won 26% over 2020-26; 9 is the middle. Defined from week 1. Falls back to the old rule where a projection is missing. Formerly duplicated on the league sheets as 'Number of wins with pregame avg max PF from opponent' — removed; UPST is the single source.
Equation (API stats only): team_week: [win(t,w) = 1 ∧ EP(t,w) − EP(o(t,w),w) ≤ −9], EP = the team's Enhanced Projection (falls back to [win ∧ pavg(t,w) < pavg(o,w)], pavg = mean_{w' < w, same y} MaxPF, where it is missing). league: Σ_t of it

Formula: League-wide sum of team_week 'Donuts (starters)' (started players who scored exactly 0).
Notes: Companion to 'Donuts (roster)' (all rostered players). Starter-only version. Every started 0 counts — you fielded them, so bye / injury / suspension is not excluded (unlike the bench portion of 'Donuts (roster)').
Equation (API stats only): Σ_t Σ_w Σ_{p ∈ S(t,w)} [pts(p,w) = 0]

Formula: Max single-starter fantasy score league-wide over the period (week / season / all-time).
Notes: 'Difference between highest and lowest starters' is the gap to the lowest.
Equation (API stats only): max{ pts(p,w) : p ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), w ∈ period }

Formula: Min single-starter fantasy score league-wide over the period.
Notes: Can be negative (a started QB with a net-negative game).
Equation (API stats only): min{ pts(p,w) : p ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), w ∈ period }

Formula: DISTINCT trade events (by timestamp) the team / league was in that were dated BEFORE that season's kickoff (its first NFL game, by league (ET) day: Sept 4-10 depending on the year). Each trade counts once regardless of how many teams were involved.
Notes: Year sheets per season; all-time sums across seasons (a trade lives in one season). Replaces the per-team 'Number of trades' which multi-counted multi-team trades. 2020 counts the startup draft-day slot swap (AceMatthew <-> LWebs53, 2020-09-09), the league's only trade before its first kickoff.
Equation (API stats only): |{ts(x) : type(x) = trade, t ∈ rosters(x), d(x) < kick(y)}|,  kick(y) = min_team gd(team, y, 1); league: over all t  — where ts(x) = transaction timestamp (Sleeper transactions → status_updated); kick(y) = min over teams of gd(team, y, 1)

Formula: DISTINCT trade events on/after that season's kickoff. Counted once per trade.
Notes: Year per season; all-time sums.
Equation (API stats only): |{ts(x) : type(x) = trade, t ∈ rosters(x), d(x) ≥ kick(y)}|  — where ts(x) = transaction timestamp (Sleeper transactions → status_updated); kick(y) = min over teams of gd(team, y, 1)

Formula: Offseason trades + Inseason trades — all distinct trade events the team / league was in.
Notes: Each multi-team trade counts once.
Equation (API stats only): |{ts(x) : type(x) = trade, t ∈ rosters(x), season(x) = y}|  — where ts(x) = transaction timestamp (Sleeper transactions → status_updated)

Formula: The fantasy team (manager) that rostered the player for the most time over the period. Reconciles transaction-tenure duration with the player's rostered weeks in player_week, so a teleport (a roster carryover with no transaction, e.g. a season-boundary carry) still counts toward the team that actually held him longest.
Notes: Manager name; links to its team_all_time row. The player_week reconciliation was added to stop an early, short tenure from outranking a long teleport tenure (Daniel Jones read shmuel256 for JacobRosenzweig). A tenure that has not ENDED is measured to the ledger's as-of clock — the most recent fantasy week whose games are final, or the league's latest roster move when that is later — not to the moment the build ran, so an in-progress season's answer does not move between two builds that saw the same data.
Equation (API stats only): argmax_t [Σ_{tenures of p on t} (in-season seconds of the tenure, open tenures to asof) + 604800·|{w : ro(p,t,w)}|]  — where asof = the latest week whose games are final, or the latest roster move if later

Formula: Alias of 'Top team' (capitalised header on player_year): the manager who rostered the player longest over the season.
Notes: Same definition as 'Top team'.
Equation (API stats only): argmax_t Σ_{tenures of p on t within season y} days on t

Formula: The fantasy team that held the player at the END of the season (in-season window only, so an offseason move doesn't overwrite it). All-time reconciles the last tenure event with player_week: a tenure event that predates the player's last rostered season is treated as stale, so the team he was actually on most recently wins (a teleported player isn't stuck on an old team).
Notes: Manager name; links to its team_all_time row.
Equation (API stats only): t with ro(p,t,w_last) = 1, w_last = p's last rostered in-season week of y (all-time: of his last rostered season)

Formula: The player's age in decimal years as of that week (birth_date vs the week's date). Per-season = mean weekly age (≈ mid-season).
Notes: Anchored to the week, not today. Blank with no birth_date.
Equation (API stats only): age(p, dw(y,w)) = (Sep 1 of y + 7(w−1) − birth(p)) / 365.25; player_year = mean_w  — where dw(y,w) = Sep 1 of y + 7(w − 1)

Formula: TRUE in the player's rookie NFL season.
Equation (API stats only): [y = rookie_year(p)],  rookie_year = Sleeper metadata rookie year, else current season − yexp(p)  — where yexp(p) = years of NFL experience (Sleeper /players/nfl → years_exp)

Formula: TRUE when the player was rostered, scored 0, did not APPEAR, and it wasn't a bye or suspension. From the in-house weekly injury tracker, backed by nflverse. "Appear" is nflverse's weekly stats UNIONED with its snap counts — the stats file lists only players who recorded a countable statistic, so on its own it flagged a scoreless week on the field as an injury. For 2020-2025, a player researched as a game-day ACTIVE who never took a snap (a backup quarterback, a depth back) is not flagged either: data/game_day_status.csv records each such week with its source, and an inactive, emergency third quarterback, reserve-list or ruled-out-in-warmups week stays flagged.
Notes: A player who scored > 0 is never flagged. Suspension wins over injury; bye wins over both. It is the RESIDUAL bucket, not a medical claim: a healthy scratch declared Out lands here (13 of the 33 flags in 2026 wk1 are "Out" with injury_body_part "Coach's Decision"). data/injury_tracker.csv keeps the body part, so a medical-only rate can be taken from there.
Equation (API stats only): INJ(p,w) = ro(p,·,w) ∧ pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ ¬APP(p,y,w) ∧ ¬BYE(p,w) ∧ ¬SUS(p,w) ∧ ¬[GDS(p,y,w) = active]

Formula: TRUE when the player was serving an NFL suspension, or was on the commissioner exempt list (Sleeper's injury_status NA), that week.
Notes: Takes precedence over Injury?; bye wins over both. COUNTED in Hardship, exactly like an injury — the missed-week test is `points == 0 and (injury or suspension) and not bye` (src/lotg.py). This note used to read "excluded from Hardship", which was wrong: only a BYE is excluded.
Equation (API stats only): SUS(p,w) = ¬BYE(p,w) ∧ (SUSP(p,y,w) ∨ injS(p) = 'NA' for week w)

Formula: TRUE when the player had no NFL game that week — his team was on bye, or he had no active NFL team at all (retired / unsigned, NFL team = 'NFL').
Notes: Wins over Injury? and Suspension?; excluded from Hardship. The no-team clause keeps retired meme-pickups out of injury counts.
Equation (API stats only): BYE(p,w) = [pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ (nfl(p,y,w) = 'NFL' ∨ no game for nfl(p,y,w) in week w of schedules)]

Formula: How much of his team's starting score a started player provided. player points / team PF; blank for bench players.
Notes: Drives the weekly Captain / One-man army awards.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) / PF(t,w) if st(p,t,w) = 1, else blank

Formula: This week's points minus his prior PLAYED week's points.
Notes: Blank on bye/injury/suspension weeks and in his first played week; the next played week bridges the gap.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − pts(p,w⁻),  w⁻ = p's previous week with H; blank if ¬H(p,w)

Formula: This week's points minus the average of his previous 5 PLAYED weeks — is he heating up or cooling off?
Notes: Non-played weeks are excluded from the baseline and are themselves blank.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − mean{pts(p,w') : the 5 latest w' < w with H(p,w')}

Stat: Change from career average to that point
Formula: This week's points minus his career PPG through the prior week (played weeks only).
Notes: Blank on bye/injury/suspension weeks and in his very first career week.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − mean{pts(p,w') : w' < w, H(p,w')}

Formula: This week's points minus his full-career PPG (all played weeks).
Notes: Non-played weeks are excluded from the baseline and are themselves blank.
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − mean{pts(p,w') : all w' with H(p,w')}

Formula: Running count of consecutive weeks the player has been on his current team, through this week.
Notes: Resets when he joins a new team.
Equation (API stats only): |{w' ≤ w : contiguous run of weeks with ro(p,t,w') = 1}|

Formula: A player's whole tenure with one team, terminal-encoded (value on his last week there, 'In Progress' before) so a sort ranks each player-team run once. '% of starts' = started / rostered weeks; '% of team points' = his starter points / the team's starter PF (0-1); the rest are weeks, points, and PPG as a starter or on the bench, and weeks as the team's top/bottom starter.
Notes: Separate stints with the same team share one tenure. Each column has a '… this season' sibling that resets per year.
Equation (API stats only): over p's tenure weeks U = {w : ro(p,t,w)}: % of starts = Σ_U st / |U|; % of team points = Σ_U st·pts(p,w) / Σ_U Σ_{q ∈ S(t,w)} pts(q,w); weeks = |U|; points/PPG as starter = Σ_U st·pts, ÷ Σ_U st; bench = same with (1 − st); top/bottom starter weeks = Σ_U [p = argmax/argmin_{S(t,w)} pts]; value shown on the tenure's last week (RUN encoding)  — where U = p's weeks with ro(p,t,w) = 1 in this stint run

Formula: Season / career totals across all teams. Rostered = started + benched weeks; '% of starts' = started / rostered; 'Total points as starter' = his starter points; '% of league points' = those points / the league's whole starter scoring (0-1).
Notes: 'Weeks as starter', 'PPG starter', and 'Times as Highest/Lowest starter on team?' are the other non-team versions.
Equation (API stats only): rostered = Σ_w ro(p,·,w); % of starts = Σ st / Σ ro; total points as starter = Σ st·pts(p,w); % of league points = Σ st·pts / Σ_{t,w} Σ_{q ∈ S(t,w)} pts(q,w)

Formula: Rostered weeks that were not a bye, an injury or a suspension week — the weeks he was available to play. Weeks rostered minus bye, injury (Weeks missed due to injury) and suspension (Weeks missed due to suspension) weeks.
Notes: The same 'played' weeks the Adjusted averages divide by, and the per-season/career version of player_additions' 'Games played on team'.

Formula: Benched weeks that were not a bye, an injury or a suspension week — weeks he was available and sat anyway.
Notes: Healthy weeks rostered = healthy starts + Healthy weeks on bench. 'Weeks on bench' is the gross count (unavailable weeks included).
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro ∧ ¬st ∧ H(p,w)}|

Formula: Share of his healthy weeks he started: starts in healthy weeks / Healthy weeks rostered (0-1). A start in a bye, injury or suspension week counts in neither side.
Notes: The available-weeks counterpart of '% of starts', and the same definition as the add_drops / player_additions 'Injury adjusted % of starts made while rostered'. N/A when he had no healthy week (no weeks he could have started, which is not a 0% start rate).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : ro ∧ H} st(p,·,w) / |{w : ro ∧ H}|; N/A if 0

Formula: Points he scored in the weeks he was benched (the league's own points, player_week).
Notes: The bench counterpart of 'Total points as starter'; the two sum to his rostered points. 'PPG bench' = this / Weeks on bench.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : ro ∧ ¬st} pts(p,w)

Stat: Number of consecutive weeks on bench before start (if starter)
Formula: On a week he STARTS, how many weeks in a row he sat on the bench just beforehand.
Notes: Only populated on a starting week.
Equation (API stats only): if st(p,t,w): |{maximal run of w' < w with ro ∧ ¬st}|

Stat: Number of consecutive weeks on bench before start excluding injury/bye (if starter)
Formula: Same as the previous column, but weeks he was unavailable (injury / bye / suspension) don't count as benched.
Notes: Only populated on a starting week.
Equation (API stats only): if st(p,t,w): |{maximal run of w' < w with ro ∧ ¬st, weeks with ¬H skipped}|

Stat: Difference from best startable bench (if starter)
Formula: For a STARTER: his points minus the best bench player he could have started instead. Negative = a benched player beat him.
Notes: That bench player is named in 'Reference player name'.
Equation (API stats only): if st(p,t,w): pts(p,w) − max{pts(b,w) : b ∈ R(t,w)∖S(t,w), b slot-eligible}

Stat: Difference from worst benchable starter (if bench)
Formula: For a BENCH player: his points minus the weakest starter he could have replaced. Positive = he should have played.
Equation (API stats only): if ¬st(p,t,w): pts(p,w) − min{pts(s,w) : s ∈ S(t,w), p eligible for slot(s)} (empty slot = 0)

Formula: The player the start/sit difference is measured against that week — the best startable bench player, or the worst benchable starter.
Notes: Links to that player's player_week row for the same year and week. 'Empty slot' when the team left a starting slot empty that week: it scored 0, so it is the worst starter (not linked).
Equation (API stats only): the argmax b (starter row) / argmin s (bench row) of the two equations above; 'Empty slot' if S(t,w) has a '0'

Stat: Difference in averages of best/worst startables over previous 5 games
Formula: The same best-bench / worst-starter comparison, but on each side's average over its previous 5 regular-season NFL games (nflverse game log, re-scored with the league's scoring for that season — 2020's ESPN rules for 2020 and the two years before it; rostered or not, across seasons; a snap with no stat line counts as 0) instead of this week's single score.
Notes: Smooths out one-week noise in the start/sit signal. A rookie averages the games he has; anyone else with fewer than 5 is N/A, as is a rookie before his first game.
Equation (API stats only): avg5(p) − avg5(ref),  avg5(q) = mean of npts(q,·,·) over q's last 5 regular-season NFL games before week w (stat line or snap; snap-only = 0); ref = the best startable bench / worst benchable starter  — where avg5(q) = mean npts(q) over q's last 5 regular-season NFL games before week w (APP; a snap with no stat line = 0)

Formula: The start/sit difference, halved when '- Activated Cuff?' is TRUE (he only started because the player he backs up was hurt).
Notes: Pairs with '- Activated Cuff?'.
Equation (API stats only): (pts(p,w) − pts(ref,w)) · (½ if ⟨Activated Cuff?⟩(p,w) else 1)

Stat: - Activated Cuff? (Did he start while a teammate he is the handcuff for was injured?)
Formula: TRUE when he STARTED this week, the team rosters a same-NFL-team, same-position teammate who averages 10+ PPG more than him, or 13+ PPG as a TE (other positions: the position-adjusted equivalent), or was a top-12 pick in that season's rookie draft — the same handcuff test as 'Cuff at time of pickup?', judged against that week's roster at its first kickoff, averages over each player's last 8 played NFL games before the week (8 a hard cutoff for the teammate), and one of those qualifying teammates is injured this week.
Notes: Feeds the Cuff adjusted difference and 'Number of cuffs started'.
Equation (API stats only): st(p,t,w) ∧ ∃ q ∈ R(t,w_kick): nfl(q)=nfl(p), pos(q)=pos(p), TEST(q,p,w) ∧ INJ(q,w)  — where w_kick = the roster as of week w's first game

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the highest-scoring starter league-wide.
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Player of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w)} pts(p',w)]

Stat: Times as Player of the week?
Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring starter league-wide.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Player of the week?⟩(p,w)

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the highest-scoring QB starter.
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as QB of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), pos = QB} pts(p',w)]

Stat: Times as QB of the week?
Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring QB starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨QB of the week?⟩(p,w)

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the highest-scoring RB starter.
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as RB of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), pos = RB} pts(p',w)]

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring RB starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨RB of the week?⟩(p,w)

Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as WR of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), pos = WR} pts(p',w)]

Stat: Times as WR of the week?
Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring WR starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨WR of the week?⟩(p,w)

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the highest-scoring TE starter.
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as TE of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w), pos = TE} pts(p',w)]

Stat: Times as TE of the week?
Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring TE starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨TE of the week?⟩(p,w)

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the lowest-scoring starter (no winner if 2+ tie at 0).
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Benchwarmer of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmin_{p' ∈ ∪_t S(t,w)} pts(p',w)], none if ≥ 2 tie at 0

Stat: Times as Benchwarmer of the week?
Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the lowest-scoring starter (no winner if 2+ tie at 0).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Benchwarmer of the week?⟩(p,w)

Formula: TRUE the week the player was the highest-scoring QB left on a bench.
Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Bench QB of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t R∖S(t,w), pos = QB} pts(p',w)]

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring QB on a bench.

Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Bench RB of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t R∖S(t,w), pos = RB} pts(p',w)]

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was the highest-scoring RB on a bench.

Notes: One per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Bench WR of the week?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ ∪_t R∖S(t,w), pos = WR} pts(p',w)]

Notes: One per team per week (alphabetical tie-break). Count is 'Times as Highest starter on team?'.
Equation (API stats only): [p = argmax_{p' ∈ S(t,w)} pts(p',w)]

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the player was his team's lowest-scoring starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Lowest starter on team?⟩(p,w)

Sheet: player_week / player_year / player_all_time / team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Count of add/drop roster moves (waiver claims, free-agency pickups, pure drops, commissioner moves) in the period — for that player on player sheets, for the team/league on team/league sheets. Rolls week → year → all-time.
Notes: Trades are NOT add/drops and are excluded here; see Total transactions for the combined count (add/drops + trades). On weekly sheets a week runs Tuesday-Monday, by the move's date: a move on the Tuesday or Wednesday after week N's games counts in week N+1.
Equation (API stats only): |{x : type(x) ∈ {waiver, free_agent, commissioner}, status = complete, subject ∈ adds(x) ∪ drops(x) (player) or roster of x = t (team) or any (league), fw(d(x)) ∈ period}|

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Count of add/drop rows in the period whose claim type is waiver and that added a player.
Notes: Subset of Number of Add/Drops. Waiver adds + free agency adds + pure drops = Number of Add/Drops exactly: a commissioner add counts as a free agency add, a commissioner drop as a pure drop.
Equation (API stats only): |{x counted in Number of Add/Drops : type(x) = waiver, adds(x) ≠ ∅}|

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Count of add/drop rows in the period that added a player without a waiver claim: free-agency pickups, plus commissioner adds (an acquisition not won on waivers).
Notes: Subset of Number of Add/Drops. With waiver adds and pure drops it partitions Number of Add/Drops.
Equation (API stats only): |{x counted : type(x) ∈ {free_agent, commissioner}, adds(x) ≠ ∅}|

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Count of add/drop rows in the period that dropped a player without adding one (a drop with no paired add).
Notes: Subset of Number of Add/Drops.
Equation (API stats only): |{x counted : adds(x) = ∅, drops(x) ≠ ∅}|

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Every roster move of either kind in the period: Number of Add/Drops + the trade count (Total trades on year/all-time sheets, Number of trades on weekly sheets).
Notes: This is the combined figure the pre-rename 'Number of transactions' column reported.
Equation (API stats only): ⟨Number of Add/Drops⟩ + |{trades : t ∈ rosters(x), fw(d(x)) ∈ period}|  (year/all-time: distinct ts(x))  — where ts(x) = transaction timestamp (Sleeper transactions → status_updated)

Formula: Count of DROPS of this player in the period.
Notes: Rolls week → year → all-time.
Equation (API stats only): |{x : drops(x)[p] defined, fw(d(x)) ∈ period}|

Sheet: player_week / player_year / player_all_time / team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Count of trades involving the row's subject in the period. On weekly sheets a week runs Tuesday-Monday, by the trade's date.
Notes: On team/league year/all-time sheets, superseded by Offseason/Inseason/Total trades (multi-team trades counted once).
Equation (API stats only): |{x : type(x) = trade, subject ∈ assets(x) / rosters(x), fw(d(x)) ∈ period}|

Formula: Mean points over every week the player was rostered here (started or benched).
Notes: Most derived metrics use the Adjusted variant instead.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : ro(p,t,w) = 1 }  (team sheets: per team)

Formula: Mean points per PLAYED week — bye/injury/suspension weeks dropped from the denominator.
Notes: What most derived metrics use.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : ro ∧ H(p,w) }

Formula: The player's total NFL fantasy points that season — every NFL game, even weeks he wasn't rostered here.
Notes: From nflverse (re-scored with league settings), not LOTG rosters.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w) over all APP weeks of y

Formula: The player's total NFL fantasy points across his whole career — every NFL game in every season.
Notes: From nflverse, not LOTG rosters.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{y,w} npts(p,y,w) over all APP weeks

Formula: Per-game mean of Points (full season).
Notes: From nflverse, not LOTG rosters.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w) / |{w : APP(p,y,w)}|

Formula: Per-game mean of the player's career NFL points. Points (full career) / career games.
Notes: From nflverse, not LOTG rosters.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{y,w} npts(p,y,w) / |{(y,w) : APP(p,y,w)}|

Formula: Mean points in the player's STARTED weeks.
Notes: Blank if he never started that period.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : st(p,·,w) = 1 }

Formula: Mean points in the player's BENCHED weeks.
Notes: Blank if he never benched that period.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : ro ∧ ¬st }

Formula: PPG starter counting only played weeks (bye/injury/suspension dropped).
Notes: Blank if he never started.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : st ∧ H }

Formula: PPG bench counting only played weeks (bye/injury/suspension dropped).
Notes: Blank if he never benched.
Equation (API stats only): mean{ pts(p,w) : ro ∧ ¬st ∧ H }

Formula: How much better the player scored when started vs benched, over PLAYED weeks: Adjusted PPG starter − Adjusted PPG bench.
Notes: A missing side counts as 0 (a player never benched reads his whole Adjusted PPG starter); blank only when he has no played week at all.
Equation (API stats only): mean{pts : st ∧ H} − mean{pts : ro ∧ ¬st ∧ H}  (missing side = 0)

Formula: How many different managers rostered the player during the season / career.
Notes: Counts every team that held him at any point, even partial weeks.
Equation (API stats only): |{t : ∃ w ∈ period, ro(p,t,w) = 1}|

Formula: Count of weeks the player was a starter over the period.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w st(p,·,w)

Formula: Win % of the fantasy teams over the weeks the player STARTED (a tie counts as half a win). Wins in those weeks ÷ started weeks with a result.
Notes: Requires at least 5 started weeks with a result in the period; N/A below that (avoids noisy small-sample rates).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : st(p,t,w)} win(t,w) / |{w : st(p,t,w), game played}|; N/A if that count < 5

Formula: Win % of the fantasy teams over every week the player was ROSTERED (starter or bench; a tie counts as half a win). Wins ÷ rostered weeks with a result.
Notes: Requires at least 5 rostered weeks with a result in the period; N/A below that (avoids noisy small-sample rates).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : ro(p,t,w)} win(t,w) / |{w : ro(p,t,w), game played}|; N/A if < 5

Formula: Season-champion membership flags. The champion is that season's Final winner. 'Rostered by champion?' = on the champion's roster at any point; 'Started by champion?' = started by the champion in any week; 'Started in championship game?' = started for the champion in the Final.
Notes: Booleans on player_year; the player_all_time versions ('Championships rostered by / started by / started in') count how many distinct title seasons each applied to. Blank for an in-progress season (no champion yet).
Equation (API stats only): champ(y) = winner of the Final in WB(y); rostered = [∃ w ∈ y : ro(p, champ, w)]; started = [∃ w : st(p, champ, w)]; started in final = [st(p, champ, w_final)]

Formula: Career counts of league titles the player was part of: 'rostered by' = # champion rosters he was on; 'started by' = # champions that started him in a week; 'started in' = # championship games (Finals) he started in.
Notes: Counts of distinct title seasons; the per-season booleans are on player_year ('Rostered by champion?' etc.).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_y [∃ w : ro(p,champ(y),w)]; Σ_y [∃ w : st(p,champ(y),w)]; Σ_y [st(p,champ(y),w_final(y))]  — where w_final(y) = the week of WB(y)'s Final

Formula: Count of weeks the player was rostered, scored 0, and was flagged injured.
Notes: League sheets carry the league-wide total.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro(p,·,w) ∧ pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ INJ(p,w)}|

Formula: Count of weeks the player was rostered, scored 0, and was flagged suspended.
Notes: League sheets carry the league-wide total.
Equation (API stats only): |{w : ro(p,·,w) ∧ pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ SUS(p,w)}|

Stat: Change in points from previous season
Formula: This season's full-season total points minus last season's.
Notes: Blank for a rookie year / no prior season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w) − Σ_w npts(p,y−1,w)

Stat: Change in avg points from previous season
Formula: This season's full-season avg points minus last season's.
Notes: Blank with no prior season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w)/n(p,y) − Σ_w npts(p,y−1,w)/n(p,y−1),  n = |{w : APP}|

Formula: This season's full-season total points minus the player's career baseline.
Notes: Blank with no career baseline yet.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w) − (Σ_{y' < y} Σ_w npts(p,y',w)) / |{y' < y with games}|

Stat: Change in avg points from career
Formula: Whether the player is above or below his career rate this season. This season's per-game avg (full NFL season) minus his prior-career per-game avg.
Notes: From nflverse (every active NFL week). Blank with no career baseline or a season under 2 games (too small to compare an average).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w npts(p,y,w)/n(p,y) − Σ_{y' < y} Σ_w npts(p,y',w) / Σ_{y' < y} n(p,y'); blank if n(p,y) < 2

Formula: TRUE if the player can be stashed on a taxi/practice squad: he's in his FIRST LOTG season AND has never started a LOTG week.
Notes: Resets at week 1 of his second season. A never-started vet from an earlier season is NOT eligible — only current-season newcomers who haven't started.
Equation (API stats only): [current season = p's first season with any ro(p,·,w) ∧ Σ_w st(p,·,w) = 0]

Formula: The team's starting-lineup points (points for) that week. In the Semifinal week the higher seed in each matchup gets +5 homefield, so its PF = Σ starters + 5.
Notes: Rolls up to season/all-time totals and averages; drives standings and Luck.
Equation (API stats only): PF(t,w) = P(t,w) + 5·[w = pws(y) ∧ t is the better regular-season seed of a semifinal pair]

Formula: The opponent's PF that week — points scored against this team.
Notes: Drives Margin and Differential.
Equation (API stats only): PA(t,w) = PF(o(t,w), w); year/all-time = Σ_w

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: The team's best-possible lineup score that week from its rostered players.
Notes: Used for Efficiency and the optimal-lineup metrics.
Equation (API stats only): MaxPF(t,w) = OPT({pts(p,w) : p ∈ R(t,w)}, y); year/all-time/league = Σ

Formula: How much the team won or lost by. PF − Points against (positive = won).
Notes: Summed over the period = Differential.
Equation (API stats only): PF(t,w) − PA(t,w)

Stat: Margin entering SNF / Monday / last game
Formula: Where the matchup stood going into that stage: own points going in − the opponent's points going in (positive = ahead). Points going in = PF minus the starters' points from games kicking off at or after the stage, so the semifinal +5 counts from the start. SNF = the week's first Sunday game at 7 pm ET or later; Monday = the first game after Sunday (2020's Tuesday / Wednesday makeups are part of it); last game = the latest kickoff with a starter from either side of the matchup, pulled back to the first kickoff of any of the matchup's games still being played then (a game is over 3 hours after kickoff: the late half of a Monday doubleheader is entered when the early half kicks off), only if it is SNF or later.
Notes: N/A when the week has no such game (no Monday game, e.g. 2023 week 17; the abandoned 2022 week 17 Bills-Bengals Monday game counts) or, for last game, when both sides' last starter played by Sunday afternoon. Games kicking off together are one stage. lotg_support.gametime.
Equation (API stats only): IN(t,w,T) − IN(o(t,w),w,T), IN(t,w,T) = PF(t,w) − Σ_{p ∈ S(t,w), ko(nfl(p,y,w),y,w) ≥ T} pts(p,w); T = first Sunday ko ≥ 19:00 (SNF) / first ko after Sunday (Monday) / start of the last kickoff window over S(t,w) ∪ S(o,w) (a ko opens a window iff ≥ 3h after the previous ko) if ≥ Sunday 19:00 (last game); no such T → N/A  — where ko(team,y,w) = Kickoff (ET date and time) of the NFL team's week-w game; none = bye (nflverse schedules games.csv → gameday + gametime)

Stat: Comebacks entering SNF / Monday / last game
Formula: What the team overcame from that stage on, when it won. Margin overcome = how far behind it was at that moment (−'Margin entering'), when it was behind. Points overcome = the opponent's FINAL score − own points going in (as in 'Margin entering'), when that is above 0. % of opponent's final points overcome = points overcome ÷ the opponent's final; % of opponent's score overcome = margin overcome ÷ the opponent's points going in. The per-player versions divide points / margin overcome by the team's own starters still to play from that stage on. % of own points scored SNF / Monday or later (in last game) = own points from that stage on ÷ PF, for every game with that stage, comeback or not. The overcome columns are N/A when there was no comeback; all are N/A with no such stage.
Notes: Points overcome is judged against the opponent's final, so the opponent's own late players count — and a team ahead going in whose opponent then pulled clear has one (margin overcome N/A). Per-player N/A with no own starter left. Percents are stored as fractions. lotg_support.gametime.
Equation (API stats only): M = IN(t,w,T) − IN(o(t,w),w,T); margin overcome MO = −M when win(t,w) = 1 ∧ M < 0; points overcome D = PF(o(t,w),w) − IN(t,w,T) when win(t,w) = 1 ∧ D > 0; else N/A; D / PF(o(t,w),w); MO / IN(o(t,w),w,T); D / L and MO / L, L = |{p ∈ S(t,w) : ko(nfl(p,y,w),y,w) ≥ T}| (N/A when L = 0); own share (PF(t,w) − IN(t,w,T)) / PF(t,w) — IN as in ⟨Margin entering SNF / Monday / last game⟩  — where ko(team,y,w) = Kickoff (ET date and time) of the NFL team's week-w game; none = bye (nflverse schedules games.csv → gameday + gametime)

Formula: How big a comeback the team made, in standard deviations, for every game. At a kickoff, the expected final margin = the margin going in + the pre-kickoff expected points of the team's starters still to play − the opponent's; its spread = 1.8 × √(the expected points still to play on both sides); z = expected final margin ÷ spread, win chance = Φ(z). Depth of a hole = −z when z < 0, where a team behind on the scoreboard has its expected final margin cut by a projection-error band of 1.6 × √(starters still to play) first (down 57.38 with 4 left and projected 58 or 60 is a comeback; projected 69.4 is not). Comeback size = the deepest hole × the win chance at any later kickoff (1 at the end for a win, 0 for a loss) × (¼ + ¾ × the share of the turnaround in between made by the team's own players: their points over expectation ÷ that plus the opponent's points short of expectation). Points in time are kickoff windows: a kickoff starts one only when every earlier game is over (3 hours after kickoff), so 4:05 + 4:25 or a Monday doubleheader is one window and no game is ever counted as finished while still being played. The stage versions take the hole at that stage only; plain Comeback size takes it at the start of every window of the matchup but the first, so a game decided in the first Thursday game scores 0.
Notes: 0.00 = never behind its expected finish. A win from a hole on the team's own players scores the whole depth (1.0 ≈ a 16% win chance, 2.0 ≈ 2%); a lead that only survived because the opponent's late players fell short counts a quarter; a loss scores the comeback it was on course for at its best moment. Expected points are the Enhanced projections (player_week 'Enhanced Projection': Sleeper, ESPN, FantasyPros and the Claude projections combined with Vegas lines and form; a starter known to be out expects 0), the same ones the Boldness stat judges lineups on. Spread chosen by log loss over 2020-25. lotg_support.gametime.
Equation (API stats only): μ(p,w) = EP(p,w) (Enhanced Projection; 0 if out: flagged ∧ pts = 0), else (Σ_{w'<w, same season} pts(p,w') + 4·avg_{y−1}(p) + 6·m_pos(<w)) / (n + 4·[played y−1] + 6); z(T) = (IN(t,w,T) − IN(o,w,T) + Σ_{p ∈ S(t,w), ko ≥ T} μ − Σ_{p ∈ S(o,w), ko ≥ T} μ) / (1.8·√Σ_{p ∈ S(t,w) ∪ S(o,w), ko ≥ T, not out} max(μ,1)); own share s(i,j) = clip(A / (A + B), 0, 1), A = Σ_{own, T_i ≤ ko < T_j} (pts − μ), B = Σ_{opp, T_i ≤ ko < T_j} (μ − pts) (0 when A + B ≤ 0); zb(T) = z(T) with the numerator − 1.6·√|{p left, not out}| when IN(t,w,T) < IN(o,w,T), else z(T); size = max_{i<j} max(0, −zb(T_i)) · Φ(z(T_j)) · (¼ + ¾·s(i,j)), Φ(z(T_end)) ↦ win(t,w); T over kickoff windows (a ko opens one iff ≥ 3h after the previous ko); stage: i = T only; plain: T_i over every matchup window but the first

Formula: Comeback size as the league saw the game in the Sleeper app: the same rules (kickoff windows, the 1.6 × √(starters left) band off a team behind on the scoreboard, depth × the later win chance × the own-doing share, a hold counting a quarter), with the starters' Sleeper Projections in place of the Enhanced ones and the app-style win % (the Pre-week Win % (X Projection) formula on points so far + the remaining starters' Sleeper Projections) in place of the calibrated win chance. Depth of a hole = −Φ⁻¹(app-style win %) when below 50%.
Notes: Kept separate from Comeback size [per user, 2026-10-07]. The app's win % is less confident than results bear out, so this scale is compressed (2020-25 max ≈ 0.6, Comeback size's ≈ 2.9): it measures how hopeless the game looked in the app, not how unlikely the comeback was. lotg_support.gametime.sleeper_comeback_columns.
Equation (API stats only): ⟨Comeback size⟩ with μ = SP(p,w), the Sleeper Projection, and z(T) = Φ⁻¹(WP_T), WP_T = ⟨Pre-week Win % (X Projection)⟩ on (IN(t,w,T) + Σ_{S(t,w), ko ≥ T} SP) v the opponent's; zb(T) = the same with 1.6·√|{p left, not out}| off the team's side when IN(t,w,T) < IN(o,w,T)

Formula: True for a win, False for a loss.
Notes: Feeds Win % and Record, which count every game (regular season + playoff/toilet brackets). A tie counts as half a win; none yet.
Equation (API stats only): win(t,w) = [PF > PA] + ½[PF = PA]  (2026+ two-week final: PF summed over both weeks)

Sheet: team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: How close the team came to its best-possible lineup. PF / Max PF.
Notes: ≤ 1; drives the Most/Least efficient awards.
Equation (API stats only): PF / MaxPF  (period: Σ PF / Σ MaxPF)

Formula: How bold it was to start him, judged on what was knowable BEFORE kickoff: the best startable bench player's Enhanced projection (player_week 'Enhanced Projection', pre-kickoff) minus his, floored at 0 (0 = no bench player was expected to outscore him). 'Startable' = available (not on bye / injured / suspended) and able to enter the lineup in his place, the other starters reshuffling among the slots that were filled (an empty slot is not a place to put him); taxi players count as bench. Expected points = his own NFL games re-scored with that season's league settings, recent games weighted most (a game's weight halves every 8 games played), earlier seasons discounted; a rookie drafted here starts from what that rookie-draft slot's picks scored as rookies, fading out by week 4; a handcuff whose starter sits out (the backup the team has been using) is lifted toward the starter's expectation, by less the weaker his own record; the backup is the one the team gave the ball to more when both played.
Notes: Starters only (N/A on bench rows, and on a dead start — a starter ruled out (bye / injured / suspended) who scored 0, judged like an empty slot). Unlike 'Difference in averages of best/worst startables', the comparison player is chosen on expectation, not on what anyone actually scored. lotg_support.boldness.
Equation (API stats only): max(0, max{XP(b,y,w) : b ∈ R(t,w) ∖ S(t,w), H(b,w), FITS(Fs ∖ {p} ∪ {b}, Σ_Fs)} − XP(p,y,w)) for a starter p; Fs = S(t,w) minus empty slots and dead starts (¬H ∧ pts = 0), Σ_Fs = their slots; N/A on bench rows, empty slots and dead starts  — where FITS(L, Σ) = L can be matched into the slot list Σ by elig_y (bipartite matching)

Formula: How far the lineup went against expectations: the expected points of the best lineup the roster allowed in the slots the manager filled, minus the expected points of the lineup actually set (expected points = the Enhanced projections, as in player_week 'Boldness'). Empty slots are not boldness (a tank, or a clinched game being coasted) — they are counted in 'Empty slots' instead; a dead start (ruled out, scored 0) is judged the same way, and counted as empty too. 0 = the lineup was the expected-points optimum.
Notes: team_year / team_all_time = the average per lineup over the weeks played (not a sum), so seasons of different lengths compare. N/A before a season's first game.
Equation (API stats only): max(0, BLV({XP(q,y,w) : q ∈ Fs ∪ {b ∈ R(t,w) ∖ S(t,w) : H(b,w)}}, Σ_Fs) − Σ_{q ∈ Fs} XP(q,y,w)), Fs = S(t,w) minus empty slots and dead starts, Σ_Fs = the filled slots; team_year / team_all_time = mean over weeks played; N/A before the season's first game  — where FITS(L, Σ) = L can be matched into the slot list Σ by elig_y (bipartite matching); BLV(V, Σ) = Σ of values taken best-first, each kept while FITS still holds and its value > 0 (exact: the startable sets form a matroid)

Stat: Combined X Projection and Combined Points above it
Formula: Both teams of the matchup together: the two teams' X Projection (and Points above X Projection) added.
Notes: Matchup block convention: on the winner's row (both on a tie) [per user, 2026-10-07].
Equation (API stats only): XP(t,w) + XP(o(t,w),w); same for PF − XP

Sheet: player_week / player_year / player_all_time / team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: A pre-kickoff projection of the player's points that week, in the league's scoring for that season. Sleeper = Sleeper's own weekly projection (Rotowire, what the league sees live). Claude = the expected points LOTG computes itself (recency-weighted NFL games, rookie draft-slot prior, next-man-up cuff lift). Enhanced = the most accurate combination found: a model over Sleeper, ESPN, FantasyPros consensus and the Claude projection with Vegas implied totals, game script, the player's record against projections, the opponent against the position, home, dome and wind, fitted on √points and refit each season on completed seasons only. team_week = the starters' projections summed (+ the semifinal bonus, so it is never 'above projection'); league_week = all teams summed; year / all-time = summed over the weeks.
Notes: A player known out that week (flagged bye / injured / suspended, scored 0) projects 0 under all three — so no projection is an 'expected if healthy' figure. Sleeper falls back to the Enhanced model fitted without Sleeper, then to Claude, where Sleeper has no projection (or ~0 for a player who was not ruled out); Enhanced falls back to Claude with no outside source. 2020-25 starters: Enhanced MAE 6.31 / RMSE 8.01 / bias 0.00, Sleeper 6.42 / 8.10 / +0.31, Claude 6.43 / 8.29 / −1.27. lotg_support.projections.
Equation (API stats only): SP(p,w) = Sleeper's projection scored with season y's rules, else EPw(p,w) (Enhanced without Sleeper), else CP(p,w); CP(p,w) = boldness E; EP(p,w) = mean_r (max(0, xᵀβ + r))², β least squares of √pts on x = [1, the 4 sources (missing → mean of the rest), √sources, sd, avg·sd, implied, avg·implied/24, opp implied, spread, spread·avg/15, form, form3, dvp, home, dome, wind] over completed seasons ≠ y; all three 0 if OUT(p,w) = flagged ∧ pts(p,w) = 0; team: Σ_{S(t,w)} + (PF − Σ_{S(t,w)} pts); league: Σ_t; year / all-time: Σ_w

Stat: Points above Sleeper / Claude / Enhanced Projection
Sheet: player_week / player_year / player_all_time / team_week / team_year / team_all_time / league_week / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: Points scored minus that projection (negative = below it). team_week = PF − the team projection; league_week = summed over teams; year / all-time = summed over the weeks.
Notes: Every rostered week counts on the player sheets (starts and bench).
Equation (API stats only): pts(p,w) − XP(p,w); team: PF(t,w) − XP(t,w); league: Σ_t; year / all-time: Σ_w

Stat: Avg Sleeper / Claude / Enhanced Projection and Avg Points above it
Sheet: player_year / player_all_time / team_year / team_all_time / league_year / league_all_time
Formula: The projection, and points above it, per week over the period (player sheets: per rostered week; team sheets: per team-week; league sheets: per league week).
Equation (API stats only): mean over the period's weeks of XP and of pts − XP

Formula: 1 for the week's highest (Overachiever) / lowest (Underachiever) Points above that projection — player_week: among starters league-wide, not counting a starter known out; team_week: among teams. Else 0.
Notes: Player: one winner a week, alphabetical by player on a tie (as Player of the week). Team: every tied team (as Highest score?). The three projections agree on the winner only part of the time (2021-25: player Overachiever 72%, Underachiever 36%; team 68% / 80%), so each keeps its own column.
Equation (API stats only): player: [p = argmax / argmin_{q ∈ S(·,w), ¬OUT(q,w)} (pts(q,w) − XP(q,w))], one winner, alphabetical tie-break; team: [PF(t,w) − XP(t,w) = max / min over teams]

Formula: All-time running count of consecutive weeks with that award — does NOT reset between seasons. TERMINAL-ENCODED (length on the final week, 'In Progress' before, 0 when broken). Player streaks skip bye / injury / suspension weeks (the run bridges them).
Notes: Sortable top-N encoding, as the other award streaks.
Equation (API stats only): run length of consecutive award weeks, all-time, terminal-encoded; player runs skip ¬H weeks

Stat: Times as / Times Overachiever / Underachiever (X Projection)
Formula: Count of weeks with that award over the period ('Times as …' on player sheets, 'Times …' on team sheets).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w award(·,w)

Formula: The 'best/worst startables over previous 5 games' comparison on each projection instead of 5-game averages, against the same reference player: for a starter, the best startable bench player's projection minus his; for a bench player, his projection minus the worst benchable starter's. Positive = the lineup call went against that projection. The 'adjusted by position' twin multiplies each side by its position factor for the season.
Notes: Added beside the previous-5 version, which stays [per user, 2026-10-07]. N/A without a reference player. A projection of 0 (known out) counts as 0.
Equation (API stats only): starter: XP(ref,w) − XP(p,w); bench: XP(p,w) − XP(ref,w), ref = Reference player ID; adjusted: each side × F(y, pos(·))

Stat: Difference in X Projection from opponent
Formula: The pregame gap on each projection: the team's X Projection (its starters' projections + the semifinal bonus) minus its opponent's. Positive = projected to win.
Notes: Added beside 'Difference in pregame avg max PF from opponent', which stays [per user, 2026-10-07]; defined from week 1.
Equation (API stats only): XP(t,w) − XP(o(t,w),w)

Sheet: player_week (Sleeper Boldness); team_week / team_year / team_all_time (Sleeper Lineup Boldness)
Formula: Boldness and Lineup Boldness judged on the Sleeper Projection — how bold the call looked in the Sleeper app: the best slot-viable, available bench player's Sleeper Projection minus the starter's (floored at 0); for the lineup, the best legal lineup's Sleeper-projected points minus the lineup set. Every other rule as Boldness: empty slots and dead starts are not boldness; team_year / team_all_time = the average per lineup.
Notes: Where Sleeper has no projection the Sleeper Projection's own fallback applies (Enhanced without Sleeper, then Claude), so an unprojected player never reads as 0 [per user, 2026-10-07].
Equation (API stats only): ⟨Boldness⟩ and ⟨Lineup Boldness⟩ with XP = SP(p,w), the Sleeper Projection

Formula: Every Hardship column again with each missed player valued at his Claude projection instead of the recent-scoring baseline: Hardship, Starter-adjusted Hardship (× the same likelihood of starting), the one-sided and two-sided hardship win / loss flips (the same healthy-lineup counterfactuals), their year / all-time sums and counts, the league_week totals and the Combined version.
Notes: The Claude projection is read BEFORE the known-out zeroing — every projection column is 0 for a week the player was out, so it can never be an 'if healthy' figure. Sleeper and ESPN do not project an injured player, which is why this is Claude and not Enhanced. A Claude projection stops updating once the player is out (McCaffrey's 2020 reads 24.1 every missed week). Luck keeps reading the original Hardship columns [per user, 2026-10-07]. 2020-26: per team-week corr 0.93 with Hardship, ~2.5 lower on average.
Equation (API stats only): ⟨Hardship⟩ and its family with each missed player's expected-if-healthy points = max(0, CP(p,w)) taken before the OUT zeroing

Formula: The Sleeper app's matchup win %, replicated and applied to each projection: A^3.757 / (A^3.757 + B^3.757), A and B = the two teams' projected totals (their starters' X Projections + the semifinal bonus). Difference = own minus the opponent's (positive = favoured). Whole percents.
Notes: Exponent fitted to the app's own win % for all 40 matchups of 2026 weeks 5-14, read off the app by the user with totals confirmed equal [2026-10-07]: every exponent from 3.751 to 3.764 reproduces all 40 to the whole percent (tests/test_win_pct.py). The app's formula is cautious: over 2020-25, favourites it puts at 75%+ won 86%, underdogs at 25% or less won 14% — but it is what the league sees.
Equation (API stats only): WP(t,w) = XA^3.757 / (XA^3.757 + XB^3.757), XA = Σ_{S(t,w)} XP + (PF − Σ_{S(t,w)} pts), XB the opponent's; difference = WP(t,w) − WP(o(t,w),w)

Formula: What a win overcame, on the app-style win %: 100% minus the team's win % pre-week, or entering SNF / Monday / its last game — the live win % there = the same formula on (points so far + the remaining starters' X Projections) for both teams, the way the app updates — when the team won from below 50% there; else N/A. Largest = the biggest of them over pre-week and the start of every kickoff window of the week.
Notes: Kickoff windows as Comeback size (never mid-game). A pre-week favourite that won overcame nothing. Whole percents.
Equation (API stats only): 1 − WP_T(t,w) when win(t,w) = 1 ∧ WP_T < ½, WP_T = WP on (IN(t,w,T) + Σ_{S(t,w), ko ≥ T} XP) v the opponent's, T = pre-week / SNF / Monday / last game; largest = max over pre-week and every window start; else N/A

Formula: Mean of the team's Pre-week Win % (X Projection) over the period's weeks.
Notes: Whole percents.
Equation (API stats only): mean_w WP(t,w)

Formula: Starting slots left empty in the lineup that week (2020: slots the ESPN lineup left unfilled), plus dead starts: starters ruled out (bye / injured / suspended) who scored 0. team_year / team_all_time = the total over the weeks played.
Notes: Kept out of Lineup Boldness, so a tank (plehv79, 2022 Toilet Semis: 6) or a clinched game coasted (shmuel256, 2020 Final: 2) shows here instead. N/A before a season's first game.
Equation (API stats only): |{i : S(t,w)[i] = '0' ∨ (¬H(S(t,w)[i],w) ∧ pts(S(t,w)[i],w) = 0)}|  (2020: ESPN slots left empty); year/all-time = Σ

Formula: The most unlucky loss: TRUE when the team LOST while being the 2nd-highest scorer of the week (only the top scorer beat it). A league in-joke.
Notes: Feeds the Luck model.

Formula: The luckiest win: TRUE when the team WON while being the 2nd-lowest scorer of the week (only the bottom scorer scored less). A league in-joke.
Notes: Feeds the Luck model.

Formula: Season / career count of the team's Brosenzweig weeks (unlucky 2nd-highest-scorer losses).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Brosenzweig⟩(t,w)

Formula: Season / career count of the team's Sisenzweig weeks (lucky 2nd-lowest-scorer wins).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Sisenzweig⟩(t,w)

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the team had the highest PF.

Formula: TRUE for the team with the lowest PF that week.

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the team had the lowest PF.

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the team won by the smallest margin.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Narrowest victory?⟩(t,w)

Formula: TRUE for the team that won by the largest margin that week.
Notes: Ties shared. Count is 'Times Largest blowout?'.
Equation (API stats only): [win(t,w) = 1 ∧ PF − PA = max_{u : win(u,w) = 1} (PF(u,w) − PA(u,w))]

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the team won by the largest margin.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w ⟨Largest blowout?⟩(t,w)

Notes: Ties shared. Count is 'Times Top half of league?'.

Formula: Season / career count of weeks the team was at or above the week's median PF.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w [PF(t,w) ≥ median_u PF(u,w)]  — where median = the middle value (mean of the two middle values for an even count)

Stat: Increase in points from previous week
Formula: PF minus last week's PF (Week 1 compares to last season's final week).
Notes: Rolls up to season averages.
Equation (API stats only): PF(t,w) − PF(t,w−1)  (w = 1: previous season's last week); league: Σ_t; year = mean

Stat: Increase in efficiency from previous week
Formula: Efficiency minus last week's Efficiency (Week 1 compares to last season's final week).
Notes: Negative = a drop. Blank in the team's first week.
Equation (API stats only): PF(t,w)/MaxPF(t,w) − PF(t,w−1)/MaxPF(t,w−1)

Formula: How many roster spots changed vs last week. max(this week's roster size, last week's) − players on both.
Notes: Counts each swap once (not drop + add). Averages to 'Average weekly roster turnover'.

Formula: How many starting spots changed vs last week. max(this week's starters, last week's) − starters on both.
Notes: Counts each swap once. Averages to 'Average weekly starter turnover'.

Stat: Difference in pregame avg max PF from opponent
Formula: Pregame talent gap on paper. The team's season-to-date average Max PF (weeks before this one) minus the opponent's.
Notes: Positive = the stronger recent roster. N/A in weeks 1-3: the average needs three games behind it.
Equation (API stats only): pavg(t,w) − pavg(o,w),  pavg(t,w) = mean_{w' < w, same y} MaxPF(t,w'); N/A for w ≤ 3

Formula: Count of the team's injured players (starters + bench) that week.
Notes: League/year/all-time carry the rolled-up versions.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} INJ(p,w)

Formula: Count of the team's suspended players that week.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} SUS(p,w)

Formula: Count of the team's players whose NFL team was on bye that week.
Notes: Byes are excluded from Hardship.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} BYE(p,w)

Formula: Count of the team's would-be-STARTERS who were injured that week.
Notes: Feeds Starter-adjusted Hardship and Loss from hardship?.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} [pts = 0 ∧ INJ ∧ ¬BYE ∧ s_h(p,w) > 0]

Formula: Count of the team's would-be-STARTERS who were suspended that week.
Notes: Feeds Starter-adjusted Hardship.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} [pts = 0 ∧ SUS ∧ ¬BYE ∧ s_h(p,w) > 0]

Formula: Points lost from injured/suspended would-be-starters, each weighted by how likely he was to start. The start-weighted version of Hardship.
Notes: Byes excluded. Drives the hardship-loss counterfactual.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} [pts(p,w) = 0 ∧ (INJ ∨ SUS) ∧ ¬BYE] · max(0, E_h(p,w)) · s_h(p,w)

Formula: How lucky or unlucky the team's result was, given how it and its opponent played — rewards unlucky losses / strong-but-beaten weeks, penalizes lucky wins. Gated by win/loss, with opponent- and own-strength, closeness, efficiency, and a hardship-loss penalty. team_year Luck = sum of weekly Luck.
Notes: Each loss-from-hardship week subtracts 0.25; calibrated so winning to talent nets ≈ 0. The result-surprise part is weighted ×1.8 in championship-bracket Semifinal and Final weeks (not 3rd Place or the toilet bracket). Full weighting in plan/LUCK_REWORK.md.
Equation (API stats only): Luck(t,w) = (0.27·OUT + 0.14·SIS − 0.14·BROS)·(1.8 if stage(t,w) ∈ PO else 1) + (0.36·OPP + 0.10·OWN)·GATE − 0.36·ADV + 0.12·EFF + 0.16·CLOSE − 0.25·LFH; OUT = win(t,w) − 1/(1 + e^(−1.5·δ)), δ = ⅓[z_all(μMax_t − μMax_o) + z_all(μPF_t − μPF_o) + z_all(μwin_t − μwin_o)] (z_all over every team-week row), OPP = z_wk(−(PA(t,w) − μPF_o)), OWN = z_wk(PF(t,w) − μPF_t), ADV = z_wk(Hard + SAHard + 3·Σ_{p ∈ R(t,w)} BYE(p,w)), EFF = z_wk(PF/MaxPF), CLOSE = sgn(m)·max(0, 1 − |m|/8), GATE = 1/(1 + |m|/15), m = PF − PA; 0 with no opponent; team_year = Σ_w Luck(t,w)  — where z_wk = clip((v − mean_{y,w} v) / sd_{y,w} v, ±2.5) / 2.5 within each league week; z_all = (v − mean v) / sd v over all rows; SIS = ⟨Sisenzweig⟩(t,w); BROS = ⟨Brosenzweig⟩(t,w); LFH = ⟨Loss from hardship?⟩(t,w); Hard = ⟨Hardship⟩(t,w); SAHard = ⟨Starter-adjusted Hardship⟩(t,w); μPF, μMax, μwin = means of PF, MaxPF, win over all of t's games in season y (subscript o: the opponent's)

Formula: Win rate over ALL games that season — regular season plus playoff/toilet-bracket games. (wins + ½·ties) / games.
Notes: 0–1 fraction. 16 games in completed 2020, 17 in each completed 2021+ season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ y} win(t,w) / |{games of t in y}|

Formula: The team's 'W-L' across ALL games that season — regular season plus playoff/toilet brackets.
Notes: Text companion to Win %.
Equation (API stats only): 'Σ_w [win = 1]' − 'Σ_w [win = 0]' over all games of y

Formula: The team's 'W-L' across every season (all games, incl. both brackets).
Equation (API stats only): 'Σ [win = 1]' − 'Σ [win = 0]' over all games

Formula: The team's win rate across every season (all games, incl. both brackets).
Notes: 0–1 fraction.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{all w} win(t,w) / |{games}|

Formula: The team's 'W-L' in REGULAR-SEASON games only (the 'Week N' matchups; brackets excluded). Per season, or pooled all-time.
Notes: The standings record. Plain 'Record' includes the brackets.
Equation (API stats only): 'Σ_{w ∈ REG} [win = 1]' − 'Σ_{w ∈ REG} [win = 0]'

Formula: Win rate over regular-season games only. (wins + ½·ties) / regular-season games.
Notes: Blank with no regular-season games yet (e.g. an in-progress season).
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ REG} win(t,w) / |{w ∈ REG}|

Formula: The team's all-time 'W-L' in championship-path games (Semifinal + Final). The 3rd-place game is separate.
Notes: '0-0' for a team that never reached the winners' bracket.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with stage(t,w) ∈ {Semifinal, Final}

Formula: Win rate in championship-path games (Semifinal + Final), all-time. 3rd-place game excluded.
Notes: Blank for a team that never reached the winners' bracket.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{stage ∈ {Semifinal, Final}} win / count

Formula: The team's all-time 'W-L' in the losers'-bracket games that crown the toilet champion (Toilet Semis + Toilet Final). The toilet-losers game is separate.
Notes: '0-0' for a team that never landed in the toilet bracket.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with stage(t,w) ∈ {Toilet Semis, Toilet Final}

Formula: Win rate in Toilet Semis + Final games, all-time. Toilet-losers game excluded.
Notes: Blank for a team that never reached the toilet bracket.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{stage ∈ {Toilet Semis, Toilet Final}} win / count

Formula: The team's all-time 'W-L' in the 3rd-place game (the two Semifinal losers). Small sample by design.
Notes: '0-0' if never played. Kept separate from Playoff record.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with stage(t,w) = 3rd Place

Formula: The team's all-time 'W-L' in the toilet-losers game (the two Toilet-Semis losers play to avoid last place). Small sample by design.
Notes: '0-0' if never played. Kept separate from Toilet bowl record.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with stage(t,w) = Toilet losers

Formula: Total points scored minus allowed over the period. Σ Margin.
Notes: Per season; all-time sums across seasons.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w (PF(t,w) − PA(t,w))

Formula: Average margin per game. Differential / games.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_w (PF − PA) / |{games}|

Formula: The team's 'W-L' in games vs that season's top-4 playoff seeds. All-time pools each season's seeds.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season (classes unknown until it ends).
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with seed(o(t,w), y) ≤ 4

Formula: Win rate in games vs that season's top-4 playoff seeds.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.

Formula: The team's 'W-L' in games vs that season's non-playoff teams. All-time pools each season's classes.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with seed(o(t,w), y) > 4

Formula: Win rate in games vs that season's non-playoff teams.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : seed(o,y) > 4} win / count

Formula: The team's 'W-L' in games vs that season's champion.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with o(t,w) = champ(y)

Formula: Win rate in games vs that season's champion.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{o(t,w) = champ(y)} win / count

Formula: The team's all-time 'W-L' vs the champions, pooling each season's champion.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.

Formula: Win rate vs the champions, all-time (pooling each season's champion).
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{o(t,w) = champ(y)} win / count, pooled over seasons

Formula: The team's 'W-L' in games vs that season's last-place team. All-time pools each season's classes.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): W-L over w with o(t,w) = last(y),  last(y) = the team with seed = N  — where last(y) = the roster with seed(·,y) = N

Formula: Win rate in games vs that season's last-place team.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{o(t,w) = last(y)} win / count  — where last(y) = the roster with seed(·,y) = N

Formula: The team's final finish that season — Champion / 2nd / 3rd / 4th from the winners' bracket, then 5th–8th for the non-playoff teams by record (PF tiebreaker).
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season. 2020–2024 finish folds in the toilet bracket (league rule then); 2025+ uses the regular season only. May disagree with the always-regular-season last-place stats.
Equation (API stats only): 1st-4th = place in WB(y) (Final winner/loser, 3rd-place winner/loser); 5th-8th = rank of non-playoff teams by (Σ win, Σ PF) (2020-24 incl. toilet bracket games, 2025+ REG only)

Formula: The regular-season week the team was mathematically out of the top-4 race — the first week 4 other teams can't be caught even if it wins out. 0 for the 4 teams that made the bracket.
Notes: Blank for an in-progress season. Regular-season weeks only.
Equation (API stats only): 0 if seed(t,y) ≤ 4; else min{w ∈ REG : |{u ≠ t : W_u(w)/n_u > (W_t(w) + n_t − g_t(w))/n_t}| ≥ 4}, W_u(w) = Σ_{w' ≤ w, REG} win(u,w'), g_u(w) = REG games played through w, n_u = REG games; no such week → the last REG week; blank for an incomplete season

Formula: Career count of league titles won.
Notes: In-progress seasons not counted.

Formula: Number of seasons the team made the top-4 playoff bracket.
Notes: In-progress seasons not counted.

Formula: Number of seasons the team reached the Final (champion or runner-up).
Notes: In-progress seasons not counted.

Formula: Number of seasons the team finished last.
Notes: In-progress seasons not counted.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_y [seed(t,y) = N]  (last in the regular-season standings; completed seasons)

Formula: Mean week-over-week roster turnover over the period.
Notes: All-time = per-season average, not a sum.
Equation (API stats only): mean_w (max(|R(t,w)|, |R(t,w−1)|) − |R(t,w) ∩ R(t,w−1)|); all-time = mean of season values

Formula: Mean week-over-week starting-lineup turnover.
Notes: All-time = per-season average.
Equation (API stats only): mean_w (max(|S(t,w)|, |S(t,w−1)|) − |S(t,w) ∩ S(t,w−1)|)

Formula: How much a team churned its full roster during the season. Players who left PLUS players who arrived between the Week-1 and championship-week rosters.
Notes: Each swap counts as 2 (a drop and an add), so a full rebuild can top 40. Per season; all-time averages.
Equation (API stats only): |R(t,w1) ∖ R(t,wF)| + |R(t,wF) ∖ R(t,w1)|,  w1 = week 1, wF = championship week; all-time = mean  — where wF = the season's last week

Formula: How much a team churned its starting lineup during the season. Starters dropped PLUS starters added between the Week-1 and championship-week lineups.
Notes: Each swap counts as 2. Per season.
Equation (API stats only): |S(t,w1) ∖ S(t,wF)| + |S(t,wF) ∖ S(t,w1)|  — where wF = the season's last week

Formula: How much a team reshaped its full roster over the offseason. Players who left PLUS players who arrived between last season's championship-week roster and this season's Week-1 roster.
Notes: Each swap counts as 2, so a near-total rebuild can top 40. Per season; all-time averages.
Equation (API stats only): |R(t,wF of y−1) ∖ R(t,w1 of y)| + |R(t,w1 of y) ∖ R(t,wF of y−1)|  — where wF = the season's last week

Formula: How much a team reshaped its starting lineup over the offseason. Starters dropped PLUS starters added between last season's final lineup and this season's Week-1 starters.
Notes: Each swap counts as 2. Per season.
Equation (API stats only): |S(t,wF of y−1) ∖ S(t,w1 of y)| + |S(t,w1 of y) ∖ S(t,wF of y−1)|  — where wF = the season's last week

Formula: How much draft capital a team used that season. Σ pick-slot value of the picks it made, on a 1/(slot+1)-style curve (earlier picks worth more).
Notes: Rookie-draft picks only. Excludes the 2020 startup and 2021 vet drafts.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{pk : by(pk) = t, rookie draft of y} 1 / (dslot(pk) + 1),  dslot = pick in round (2.09 → 8, 5.0X → 8)

Stat: Number of first round picks made

Notes: Rookie-draft picks only. Excludes the 2020 startup and 2021 vet drafts.

Formula: Count of all picks the team made that season.
Notes: Rookie-draft picks only. Excludes the 2020 startup and 2021 vet drafts.
Equation (API stats only): |{pk : by(pk) = t, rookie draft of y}|

Formula: How sticky a team's roster is: of the players on its Week-1 roster in year Y, the fraction still on its Week-1 roster in year Y+3. |roster_Y ∩ roster_Y+3| / |roster_Y|.
Notes: Blank until the Y+3 season is played (2020→2023, 2021→2024, 2022→2025 so far). A player re-acquired by Y+3 week 1 still counts. All-time averages a team's measurable years.
Equation (API stats only): |R(t,w1 of y) ∩ R(t,w1 of y+3)| / |R(t,w1 of y)|; all-time = mean

Formula: Value of the picks the team currently holds for the next 5 seasons, round-weighted (1st .25, 2nd .09, 3rd .03, 4th .01). Own retained + acquired − traded away.
Notes: team_week updates on each trade; team_year uses the season-end snapshot.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{(Y, r) : own(Y,r,·) = t at the date, Y ∈ y+1 … y+5} ω(r),  ω = {1: .25, 2: .09, 3: .03, 4: .01}; team_year = the season-end value  — where ω(r) = {1: 0.25, 2: 0.09, 3: 0.03, 4: 0.01}, 0 otherwise

Formula: League-wide QB starter points ÷ league-wide QB starts over the period: the sum of every team-week's 'Points from QBs' over the sum of its 'Number of QB started'.
Notes: Per player-START, so year / all-time divide by summed weekly starts — not by the sheet's 'Number of QB started', which counts distinct players there. Equation (API stats only): Σ_{t,w} Σ_{p ∈ S(t,w), posS(p) = QB} pts(p,w) / Σ_{t,w} |{p ∈ S(t,w) : posS(p) = QB}|

Formula: What the team gave up for him, in FAAB dollars, on the league's own currency — draft picks. Free agency and a $0 waiver claim: 0. Waiver: the winning bid. Everything else goes through one money curve: KTC places an asset on the rookie draft board (draft-day KTC per overall rookie pick, all classes pooled, made non-increasing — 'which pick is this worth?'), and dollars rise exponentially up the board from the 4.08 (its KTC ÷ 100) to $1,000 for a mid first (pick 4.5); below the 4.08 an asset is its KTC ÷ 100. That curve is then set in the day's market: the field's 49th player that day is $1,000 (where a mid first sits on average, so a real mid first floats with its class and the market); above him an asset is $1,000 × 2.619^((its KTC − his) ÷ (the day's top-10 average − his)), so the best player averages $3,500 but costs more when he stands far above a thin top 10 and less when the top is bunched; below him, half that market effect — the geometric mean of $1,000 × 8.26^((its KTC − his) ÷ (his − the day's 100th player's)) and the board curve rescaled to $1,000 at him. A PLAYER is then priced above replacement — a guy the league could pick up for free costs no FAAB: less the price of the player at the league's last rostered spot that day (roster spots × teams, taxi and IR not counted, less one per team from 2025 for the supertaxi long shot: 168 / 184 / 208 / 200; on a date KTC's data covers fewer players than that, the line is read as a fraction of the anchor from the nearest date that does), faded rather than floored, so one below the line shrinks toward $0. Picks keep their board price (the league pays $20 for a 5.0X). Draft: the pick's board value, kept as its draft-day value ÷ that draft day's anchor so a pick keeps its standing in the market on any date (KTC's level drifts: the anchor ran ~5,900 in 2020, ~4,700 in 2022-23) — a rookie pick 75% from all classes, 25% from its own (pick value moves slightly year to year), a startup / 2021 vet pick from that board (vet picks continue it) — × the day's anchor, through the curve; a rookie-draft round-5 pick (a 5.0X FAAB buy) is locked at $20. Trade: the dollars of everything sent, split across what came back by their dollars — a player through the curve, FAAB as its dollars, and a pick on the board, never by KTC: its slot's price (the average over its round when the slot is not yet set), × 0.95 for each draft it sits beyond the next one (a small discount for a future pick, as the league trades them). A pick is never priced on the slot it eventually landed in: until its order is set (the 2.09 only exists then), a pick in the next-up or current deciding season is the slot prices weighted by its original team's projected odds that day — roster strength (its best 15 players' KTC) before the season, blended toward the stat that sets the order as the season is played (half each through week 3, all in-season from week 8; record for the reverse-placement order through the 2025 draft; record for the playoff/bottom split and Max PF to date within the bottom four from 2026), the odds' spread narrowing from ±2.75 slots preseason to ±1.0 late (fitted on 2021-25); once the regular season is over the bottom four go by the rule (Max PF, or the 2025 draft's record, known outright; through the 2024 draft placement still counted the toilet bowl) and the playoff block by the bracket (5-8 open before the semifinals, winners 7-8 and losers 5-6 after); further-out picks are the round average.
Notes: Waiver bids and FAAB in trades are their dollars, untouched. Dollars add, so seven depth pieces stay cheap and one star is expensive. No depth tax (that is the 'KTC value difference' margin's fairness comparison, not a price per asset). 100 KTC = $1 still holds below the 4.08 — the rate trades use for FAAB. N/A for a commissioner move, and for a trade with an asset still unpriced.

Formula: The player's age in years on the addition date (birth date from the player dictionary).
Equation (API stats only): age(p, d_a) = (d_a − birth(p)) / 365.25

Formula: The acquisition's handcuff flag, on every channel. TRUE when, at the moment of the move, the adding team already rosters another player on the SAME NFL team and position (the reference) who either averages 10+ PPG more than the added player, or averages 13+ PPG as a TE (other positions: the position-adjusted equivalent, reference PPG x position factor >= 13 x the TE factor), or was a top-12 pick in that season's rookie draft. Both averages are the reference's last 8 PLAYED NFL games (nflverse, league scoring) before the move; the added player's own average is his last 8 (or fewer). 8 is a hard cutoff: a reference with fewer than 8 games counts only through the draft test. A Draft row carries its pick's 'Cuff when drafted?'.
Notes: Always True or False — never N/A. The same test as add_drops' 'Cuff at time of pickup?' and the pick sheets' 'Cuff when drafted?' (draft test: that season's rookie draft once it has happened; 2020 = the first 12 NFL rookies in the startup). player_week's '- Activated Cuff?' applies the same test week by week.
Equation (API stats only): CUFF(p, t, d_a)  (Draft row: CUFF at the draft)

Formula: KeepTradeCut superflex value of the player on the addition date. The non-pick-adjusted KTC checkpoints, keyed off pickup time rather than draft day.
Notes: Never pulls forward: a checkpoint dated in the future is blank, not today's value.
Equation (API stats only): K(p, d_a)

Formula: KTC superflex value at the end of the season the player was picked up in (Feb 1 of the following year).
Notes: Blank until that date has passed (never pulled forward).
Equation (API stats only): K(p, Feb 1 of y(d_a)+1); blank if in the future

Formula: KTC superflex value exactly N calendar years after the addition date (N = 1..4).
Notes: Blank when N years after pickup is still in the future (e.g. the 4-year column for a player added under four years ago) — KTC never pulls a value forward.
Equation (API stats only): K(p, d_a + N years), N = 1..4; blank if in the future

Stat: KTC change by end of season
Formula: How the player's KTC superflex value has moved since pickup: (KTC at the checkpoint) − (KTC at pickup). Positive = gained value since acquired.
Notes: Blank whenever either endpoint is blank (including a future checkpoint that never pulls forward).
Equation (API stats only): K(p, checkpoint) − K(p, d_a)

Formula: What his starts put up per week he was held: Total points as starter / Weeks rostered (started + benched weeks, byes/injuries/suspensions included). 'PPG starter' divides the same points by the starts alone.
Notes: Blank with no rostered week.

Stat: Adjusted PPG starter per rostered week
Formula: Starter points in his healthy weeks / Healthy weeks rostered — 'PPG starter per rostered week' over the weeks he was available (not a bye, an injury or a suspension week).
Notes: Blank with no healthy rostered week. A missed week scores 0, so the numerator equals Total points as starter.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : H} st(p,·,w)·pts(p,w) / |{w : ro ∧ H}|

Formula: Points added per HEALTHY start: started points in weeks that were not a bye, an injury or a suspension / those starts. 'Avg points added' counts every start, a start in a missed week (0 points) included.
Notes: 0 with no healthy start, like 'Avg points added'.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H} st·pts(p,w) / Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H} st  (0 if none)

Stat: Avg points added per rostered week
Formula: Points added (his started-week points) / Tenure (NFL weeks) — what his starts put up per week he was held.
Notes: 0 with no rostered week, like 'Avg points added'.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk} st·pts(p,w) / |Wk|

Stat: Adjusted Avg points added per rostered week
Formula: Started points in healthy weeks / Games played on team (rostered weeks that were not a bye or a missed week).
Notes: 0 with no game played, like 'Avg points added'.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk : H} st·pts(p,w) / |{w ∈ Wk : H}|

Stat: Avg points per rostered week on team
Formula: Every point he scored while rostered here (started + benched) / Tenure (NFL weeks). 'Avg PPG on team' is the same points over the games played only.
Notes: Blank if never rostered a week here.
Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ Wk} pts(p,w) / |Wk|

Notes: Blank if never benched in the tenure.

Notes: Blank with no healthy bench week.

Formula: league starter avg / position starter avg, both over one season's STARTED player_week rows — each value x the factor of the season it belongs to. A season with fewer than 5 weeks played (the season in progress through week 4, and moves filed under it before kickoff) uses the PREVIOUS season's factor; once its week 5 is in, the whole season switches to its own, retroactively. A season past every one on record uses the latest.
Notes: 5 = the week the weekly email starts showing a season's averages, so an adjusted number settles the week it is first reported. The handcuff test's TE-equivalent threshold uses the same factor. lotg_support.position_factor.

Formula: PPG starter over his regular-season starts only (weeks named 'Week N'), career.

Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ REG} st(p,·,w)·pts(p,w) / Σ_{w ∈ REG} st(p,·,w)

Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w : stage ∈ PO} st·pts(p,w) / Σ_{w : stage ∈ PO} st

Formula: Count of his regular-season starts (weeks named 'Week N'), career.

Equation (API stats only): Σ_{w ∈ REG} st(p,·,w)

Formula: Total points in his regular-season starts (weeks named 'Week N'), career.

Formula: The team's total PF in championship-bracket Semifinal and Final games, all-time — the games 'Playoff record' / 'Playoff win %' count. 3rd Place and the toilet bracket are excluded.
